policy: Per-unit single source of truth: kit-parse rollout status (kitParse.*), tuning provenance (tier/tuned/evidence — absorbed from data/hand-tuned.json 2026-07-16; tier definitions in docs/hand-tuned.md), unmodeled kit text (mirrored from the override), and board pass records (sim/real per recorded comp, >1 = HOT). AUTO fields regenerate via scripts/kit-status.ts --refresh; workflow/evidence fields are preserved. Board ratio convention: docs/CONVENTIONS.md "Ratio direction".

tiers.MEASURED: focus recording / frame-count / gauge-popup read set or confirmed the values
tiers.CALIBRATED: fitted number tuned against real fights (mechanism suspected, value is ours)
tiers.VALIDATED: total graded ~1.0 in a recorded comp (not focus-recorded)
tiers.MODEL_ONLY: parser/datamine only, never confirmed against a real fight = UNTUNED

reference_grade.definition: tuned=true AND final-total ratio within 0.97-1.03 on >=5 distinct teams (dedup by unit set; focus not required). Recompute with scripts/refgrade.ts when graded comps change.

burst/skill1: same-frame ordering convention — the engine applies the Nth burst's S1 Max HP tier BEFORE that cast's 2439.36/792 hits snapshot ATK, so cast N's nuke already benefits from tier N (observed cast amounts 14.7M→17.1M→22.0M, plateau at the 3-stack cap). ⚑ whether the game applies the tier before or after the same cast's damage is an unmeasured ordering convention; the test pins only the ordering-robust GROWTH (last cast > first cast), not the exact tier index
2b.note: BASELINE AUTHORING (kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28) — 2B (`2b`, AR/Defender/Fire/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 90 / reloadFrames 81, NieR:Automata collab, no base counterpart). First modeling; ground truth is the top-level prose (data/characters.json → characters['2b'].skills). Her damage identity is a single load-bearing SYNERGY: S1 stacks Max HP on every burst cast, and S2's passive converts final Max HP into ATK, so the more she bursts the harder every hit lands — the escalating Max HP ladder is OFFENSIVELY LIVE for her (unlike a pure Defender HP grant) precisely because she is her own atkOfMaxHpPct consumer. SKILL1 ('Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self. Effects vary according to the number of times used. Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it: Once: Max HP ▲10.03% / Twice: ▲20.06% / Three times: ▲57.76% continuously') = burstCast → self `escalating` steps [targetMaxHpPct 10.03 / 20.06 / 57.76], the canonical Liter-style cumulative-with-cap ladder (sim.ts escalating case applies steps 1..min(N,3) on the Nth activation, exactly matching 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'): 1st burst +10.03%, 2nd +10.03+20.06, 3rd+ capped at 10.03+20.06+57.76 = 87.85% Max HP. targetMaxHpPct ('Max HP ▲ X%' — the target's OWN %) is the literal-word stat (vs casterMaxHpPct '% of the skill user's Max HP'); self-targeted so caster===target and the grant arrives as an OWN-kit maxHpFlat (casterIdx===self) that effectiveAtk's e3 rule feeds into her atkOfMaxHpPct conversion (sim.ts `liveMaxHp()` + `effectiveAtk()`). Duration-less ('continuously') = permanent once applied; the three distinct values key three distinct maxHpFlat buffs that stack and refresh (no infinite re-stack), identical to Liter's validated escalating buffs. SKILL2 block A ('Activates after firing 300 time(s). Affects all enemies. Deals 167.45% of final ATK as damage') = hitCount:300 → enemy flatDamage 167.45 — RECURRING (the engine's hitCount fires every 300 cumulative hits; AR hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ every 300 shots), 'all enemies' collapses to the single immortal boss. SKILL2 block B ('Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. ATK ▲ 6.16% of the skill user's final Max HP continuously') = passive → self atkOfMaxHpPct 6.16 — 'final Max HP' = live Max HP (base + own-kit maxHpFlat stacks), read per-frame in effectiveAtk, so the S1 ladder grows this ATK add dynamically. BURST block A ('Affects all enemies. Deals 2439.36% of final ATK as distributed damage') = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 2439.36 flavor distributed ('all enemies' → the boss; distributed split is inert single-target). BURST block B ('Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest remaining HP. Deals 792% of final ATK as additional damage') = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 792 ('highest remaining HP' selection collapses to the single boss). Cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens (instant burst, ulti skill_type InstantNumber), so neither burst hit takes the +50% FB major (verified fact 2026-07-13, helm/exia precedent). ⚑1 cluster-bomb cadence: recurring-every-300-shots is the engine hitCount convention; if the real kit is a ONE-TIME 300-shot trigger the fight would carry exactly 1 proc instead of ~6 — board A/B (or a focus video popup count) is the discriminator. ⚑2 crit: all three damage hits are encoded NON-crit (the flatDamage default; helm/exia burst-nuke precedent) — absent a measurement that 2B's skill/burst procs crit, non-crit is the conservative faithful default; a measured crit rate would opt the hits in via crit:true. ⚑3 S1 ladder additive-vs-latest: encoded additive (steps sum to 87.85% at 3 stacks) per the Liter-validated escalating reading of 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'; if the real kit applies only the LATEST line (57.76% cap) the ATK conversion is ~30% smaller — the cross-family blind + board A/B adjudicate. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28: cross-family corroborated (see results/2b.json).

skill1: Explosion Radius ▲ 100.74% for 15 sec.
burst: Effect 1: Current HP ▼ 3.99% every 1 sec.
If own HP dips below 40%, Mode B is removed.

caveats: burst: Mode B ATK ▲15.19% + Charge Speed ▲35.88% use a DERIVED 22.5s duration = ln(0.4)/ln(1-0.0399), the compound (CURRENT-HP) reading of the 3.99%/s drain crossing the 40% removal floor — ⚑ if the drain is %-of-MAX-HP (linear) the lifetime is 60/3.99 = 15.04s instead; pin from footage (burst banner → visible Mode B drop). The sim has no HP pool, so the removal gate is expressed only as this finite durationSec.

burst: the derived 22.5s assumes A2 is at full HP at each burst cast — ⚑ real fights with boss damage (or healing that offsets the drain) shorten/extend Mode B; healing-based extension (crown heals in the control fixture) is out of scope with no HP pool and is NOT modeled.

skill1: 'Explosion Radius ▲ 100.74%' is unmodeled AoE-splash geometry (single-target sim) — deliberately NOT mapped to projectileExplosionPct, which would invent ~100% Damage Up out of a pure radius line.
skill2: the 30.1% full-charge rider is modeled on shotFired (every RL pull = one full charge); if a focus video shows it not firing every charged shot, retune the trigger.
skill2: Damage to Parts ▲40.88% is encoded but exactly inert vs the partless scope-lock boss (kept for kit completeness).
a2.note: BASELINE AUTHORING (kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28) — A2 (`a2`, RL/Attacker/Fire/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 6 / reloadFrames 111 / chargeFrames 60 / chargeMultiplier 250, NieR:Automata collab, no base counterpart). First modeling; ground truth is the top-level prose (data/characters.json → characters['a2'].skills). Her damage identity is a charge RL whose BURST IS A PURE SELF STATE (Mode B) — it deals NO damage; it grants ATK + Charge Speed while it drains her HP, and the drain self-terminates the state once HP < 40%. SKILL1 ('Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self. Charge Damage ▲ 110.44% for 15 sec. Explosion Radius ▲ 100.74% for 15 sec.') = burstCast → self chargeDamagePct 110.44 / 15s. 'Charge Damage ▲' is the ADDITIVE flat-points stat (chargeDamagePct): an RL full-charge shot's charge mult lifts from the bare baseCharge = chargeMultiplier/100 = 2.5 to 2.5 + 110.44/100 = 3.6044 during the window (sim.ts charge case: baseCharge + baseCharge×(chargeDamageMultPct)/100 + chargeDamagePct/100). It is NOT chargeDamageMultPct (the collection-item/Helm-treasure stat that scales BASE charge: 2.5 × (1 + 1.1044) = 5.261) — the literal 'Charge Damage ▲' wording is the additive reading. Keyed to her OWN burstCast (not fullBurstEnter — helm is co-B3 in the control fixture and takes some rotations). The 'Explosion Radius ▲ 100.74%' line is UNMODELED: it is pure AoE-splash geometry, has no per-hit damage effect against the single partless scope-lock boss, and must NOT be mapped onto projectileExplosionPct (an RL Damage-Up stat) — a radius increase moves zero damage vs one boss. SKILL2 ('Activates when hitting a target with Full Charge.') block A ('Affects the target. Deals 30.1% of final ATK as additional damage.') = shotFired → enemy flatDamage 30.1 — every RL trigger pull IS a full charge (the RL charge model fires firePull(charged=true) once the 60-frame charge completes, sim.ts:~3110), so shotFired == per-full-charge; the rider is crit-eligible (engine rider convention), noRange (riders force noRange), non-core (kit lacks 'core strike'), FB +50% by landing timing. Block B ('Affects self. Damage to Parts ▲ 40.88% for 3 sec.') = shotFired → self partsDamagePct 40.88 / 3s — parsed but INERT in v1 (partless boss; kept for kit completeness, moves nothing). BURST ('Mode B') = burstCast → self atkPct 15.19 + chargeSpeedPct 35.88, both on a DERIVED finite duration of 22.5s. Mode B has NO 'for N sec' in the kit — it lasts until 'own HP dips below 40%'; the sim models no HP pool, so the removal is captured as the effective uptime derived from the kit's OWN drain constant: Effect 1 'Current HP ▼ 3.99% every 1 sec' is a compound decay (CURRENT HP), HP(t) = (1-0.0399)^t = 0.9601^t, crossing 40% at t = ln(0.4)/ln(0.9601) = 22.5s (discrete game removes at the 23rd tick ≈ 23s; immaterial to DPS). This is a closed-form consequence of the kit constants, NOT a board fit. With a 40s burst CD the state is up ~22.5s/cycle (~56% uptime) with a ~17.5s dead gap each cycle — a PERMANENT encoding would roughly double uptime and over-credit both ATK and shot cadence. chargeSpeedPct is shot-count-bearing on a chargeFrames-60 RL (subtractive on charge time, sim.ts:~3107), so it is damage, never a skip-as-utility line; it shares the one Mode B window with the ATK buff (same applyFrame/expiresFrame). Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28: cross-family S2b (claude-fable-5) review converged FAITHFUL on all 4 load-bearing lines (leakDetected null); see results/a2.json.

skill1: Recovers 10% of the damage dealt as HP for 10 sec. — magnitude only: the 10s recovery-event WINDOW is modeled (event-only heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 on the fullBurstEnter→burstCasters block, firing bursted-B3 on-recovery consumers such as asuka S1); the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool)

caveats: burst: Special Modification is capped at maxShots 1 on the weaponSwap — the kit's literal 'for 1 round(s)', owner-confirmed 2026-08-11 (one special-charged shot per window). Pinned by the EXACTLY-one case in scripts/tests/units/ada.test.ts.
ada.note:
Ada — RL/Electric charge-attacker. Board: 0.924 COLD on 2 graded comps (0.92 / 0.93). Kit-faithfulness is certified by the unit spec, INCLUDING the Special Modification shot count: the swap carries maxShots 1, the kit's literal 'for 1 round(s)', owner-confirmed 2026-08-11 (one special-charged shot per window). She previously read 0.995 because the swap was uncapped and fired a second special shot per window; the board was leaning on damage the kit does not grant, so this is faithful > fit and the COLD reading is the honest one. Do NOT close it by uncapping the swap or shaving another value — her residual is now a magnitude question, unconfounded by the shot count.
S1 (fullBurstEnter): buffs the Burst-3 allies who ALREADY burst this rotation — kit-literal 'all Burst 3 allies who previously used their Burst Skill', encoded as target burstCasters stage 3. The stage filter is load-bearing: an unfiltered burstCasters target would feed her +60%-of-caster ATK grant to every burst caster including B1/B2 supports. Grants casterAtkPct 60 + trueDamagePct 50, 10s, plus the lifesteal's recovery-event WINDOW as an event-only heal (ticks 10, intervalSec 1) on the same block, refreshing bursted-B3 on-recovery consumers (asuka S1) once a second across the window. The HP amount has no engine consumer — there is no HP pool — so only the event is modeled.
S2 Flash Grenade Toss: a 420% True-Damage dot every 2s for 10s on EVERY Full-Burst enter, plus a SECOND identical every-2s stream on her own burstCast — that second stream is the kit's burst rider ('Flash Grenade Toss activation time condition ▼1 sec for 10 sec'), so during her own burst windows the two streams together deliver the kit's doubled rate — 10 tosses per 10s window, damage-identical to the kit's 1/s (the engine's first-tick semantics land them as pairs ~0.37s apart every 2s rather than evenly spaced). True-flavored, so her S1 and burst True Damage ▲ buffs apply to the grenades only (the engine gates trueDamagePct by flavor).
BURST: self atkPct 40 + trueDamagePct 42 (10s), and Special Modification as a weaponSwap — damagePct 61.3, chargeTimeSec 4 (the kit's Charge Speed ▼300%), chargeMultPct 1750 (base 250 + the kit's Charge Damage ▲1500), 10s.
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured unit-level pullsPerSec, so the 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her; her window is charge-time-gated in any case.

Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-03: FROM-SCRATCH build (no shipped override existed; simSupported was false) — test-first re-derivation (scripts/tests/units/ade.test.ts, groups L2/L4/L5/L6/X1). --- LINE DISPOSITIONS --- (L1, UNMODELED) S1 'Activates at the start of battle. Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.' — defensive debuff immunity; the v1 boss applies NO debuffs (nothing to be immune to) and the engine has no debuff/immunity primitive (biscuit / diesel-winter-sweets precedent for immunity-class lines). Affects all allies. ATK ▲ 5.19% of the skill user's ATK for 5 sec.' — the engine has NO ally HP pool and no HP-threshold trigger (v1 models no incoming boss damage), so the gate cannot be literally evaluated. Encoded always-on via an interval:5 refresh (first fire t=5s ≈ the first HP crossing a few seconds in; the 5s window then bridges the 5s period exactly = permanent uptime thereafter) per the mast precedent (GO 1.0 cross-family: mast's offensive 'HP falls below 70% → Crit Damage ▲50.94% continuously' shipped passive always-on as a DOCUMENTED_GAP — judge: 'the over-credit risk is the pre-onset transient'; mast's S6-blind UNMODELED position was ruled equally defensible but the always-on encoding stood). Ade's 90% threshold is easier to cross than mast's 70%, strengthening the real-fight near-full-uptime reading (one splash hit crosses it). Effect = casterAtkPct 5.19 ('% of the skill user's ATK' = flat add of ADE's ATK, the label/delta-ninja-thief convention; NOT atkPct % of each holder's own ATK) → all allies (includes self) for 5s. S2b (claude-fable-5) dissented (UNMODELED: trigger unrealizable at scope lock; over-credit risk) — recorded as the rejected alternative; the blind S5/S6/S7 roles arbitrate. Max HP ▲ 15.62% of the skill user's Max HP without restoring HP, lasts for 5 sec.' — hitCount:120 (hitsPerShot 1 collapses the pull-vs-hit lever: 120 pulls == 120 hits; the counter re-fires every crossing, no once-per-battle qualifier in prose) → casterMaxHpPct 15.62 ('% of the skill user's Max HP' = flat Max HP off ADE's own final Max HP, uniform across holders, the mast convention; NOT targetMaxHpPct per-holder own-%) → all allies for 5s. 'without restoring HP' = no heal effect (the engine heal is what emits recovery events; none is used, so no on-recovery consumer procs). (L5, MODELED — INERT) burst 'Max HP ▲ 25.15% of the skill user's Max HP without restoring HP, lasts for 10 sec.' — same encoding on burstCast (25.15/10s), same inertness. (L6, MODELED — LOAD-BEARING) burst 'ATK ▲ 10.15% of the skill user's ATK for 10 sec.' — burstCast → casterAtkPct 10.15 → all allies (includes self) for 10s; the ONLY damage-moving line in the kit. Element: boss Fire of the control fixture is NEUTRAL for Wind ade (Fire BEATS Wind ⇒ only Water units take the major; no disadvantage mechanic). No reload/ammo/gauge/weapon kit lines → no charFixes (gauge rides the AR class-modal fallback: no datamined gauge-per-shot row). --- TIER 2: status-gate kit (the L2 HP-below collapse). --- ⚑ FLAGS (all UNMEASURED): (⚑1) CADENCE TUPLE [mandatory]: AR RoF 720 / reloadFrames 111 / hitsPerShot 1 shipped datamine as-is — drives the hitCount:120 crossing cadence (~every 2 magazines + reload ≈ 13.7s) and her normals. ade-agent-bunny.note:
Ade: Agent Bunny — SR/Iron/Supporter/Burst II (NOT `ade`, AR/Wind). Board: 0.964 COLD on 1 graded comp. Kit-faithfulness: every line is pinned green vs shipped and red vs its nearest-wrong counterfactual in a 22-test spec (scripts/tests/units/ade-agent-bunny.test.ts). The kit carries no heal, shield, DEF, HP, hit-rate, reload or recurring-damage lines, so most of the standard trap list does not apply to her; what is unmeasured is the full-charge proxy, the Spy-Lens ramp and the SR cadence tuple, all ⚑ below.
S1 block 1: allies casterAtkPct 15.2 for 5s on her full-charge landings. Encoded on the `fullCharge` trigger (fires per charged pull — every SR pull in-sim) ⚑1: the LANDING and effective-range halves of the clause are still assumed true for every charged pull. The range condition is assumed always-true, since the engine force-sets noRange.
S1 block 2 — Spy Lens (self Minimum Effective Range ▲4.44%, 10 stacks, 5s) — is an inert range stat under the engine's universal noRange, so it is unmodeled as a BUFF. Its STACK COUNT is not inert, though: it gates S2 block 2, which is why the gate is encoded as a hit count rather than dropped with it.
S2 block 1: allies pierceDamagePct 18.36 for 5s on full-charge, same fullCharge trigger and the same ⚑1 landing assumption. Kept even though pierceDamagePct only feeds Damage Up for pierce-TAGGED attackers — she is one herself once Spy Lens maxes, so her own 18.36 and her burst's 10.13 self-feed.
S2 block 2 ('only if Spy Lens is at max stacks': Gains Pierce continuous + ATK ▲16% continuous) is a STEP, not a passive: both the duration-less gainPierce and the self atkPct 16 ride a hitCount:10 trigger — the 10th full-charge hit, ~16s in at ~1.37s per full charge including one reload — and stay on thereafter. Encoding the Pierce as a duration-less `gainPierce` effect rather than a top-level hasPierce flag is what makes the step expressible at all: a boolean flag cannot be gated, and would tag her from frame 0.
BURST (burstCast, B2, cd 20): allies attackDamagePct 55.04 + pierceDamagePct 10.13 for 10s. The self Minimum Effective Range ▲55.56% is an inert range stat → unmodeled; range buffs change the effective-range BAND, not shots fired, so there is no shot-count channel for it to move.
⚑1 FULL-CHARGE PROXY: every trigger pull is assumed a landed full charge within range. Unmeasured.
SPY-LENS RAMP: count:10 rests on 1 stack per full-charge hit plus the ⚑3 cadence, giving a ~15-16s onset (measured: the gated block first fires at 14.9s in her control comp, then 10 times over the fight). It is then held, because re-application refresh keeps stacks alive across the 2.35s reload (< the 5s stack duration). The refresh is no longer an assumption — OWNER RULING 2026-08-11: stacks refresh in this game unless a kit says otherwise (docs/modeling-priors.md prior 12). The counterfactual it rules out was the serious one: per-application expiry would plateau her around 3-5 stacks and the max-stacks gate would never open, making this whole S2 package dead code.
⚑3 CADENCE TUPLE: chargeFrames 60 + the default 22f bolt gap (noBoltRecovery is NOT set — it is never set unmeasured) + reloadFrames 141 + ammo 6 → ~1.37s per shot, ~10.6s per mag cycle. All datamine defaults. Recipe for all three: a focus video giving rounds/min, the reload gap, autofire behaviour, and a direct read of whether Spy Lens stacks refresh or expire individually.

alice.note:
Alice — SR/Fire (NOT `alice-wonderland-bunny`, SMG/Water). Board: 1.101 HOT on her single graded comp, PA MiKa (anis-star + mint + prika + alice + red-hood). Kit-faithfulness is verified by event-log spec in scripts/tests/units/alice.test.ts.
MODEL — 5 load-bearing lines. S1 = fullBurstEnter → the 2 highest-final-ATK allies get chargeSpeedPct 11.67 + chargeDamagePct 7, 10s. S2 = 'Gain continuous Pierce' → top-level hasPierce. BURST = burstCast → self chargeSpeedPct 80.15 + atkPct 55.12, 10s.
HER PIERCE TAG IS NOT INERT — IT IS WORTH ~+23% OF HER DAMAGE ON HER GRADED COMP, AND IT IS THE BULK OF HER HOT READ. `hasPierce` is a hit TAG: it does not double-hit (the engine's PIERCE_CORE_DOUBLE constant is false, so there is no core+body split), and on its own it moves no damage. What it does is make her ELIGIBLE for pierceDamagePct, and her only graded comp seats `mint`, whose S2 grants all allies pierceDamagePct 32.72 for 10s. Measured A/B on that comp: hasPierce on = 444M, ratio 1.100; hasPierce off = 362M, ratio 0.897 — a 22.6% swing, with every other unit in the comp byte-identical. **Do not remove the tag as dead weight, and do not read an inertness result taken in a pierce-free fixture as an inertness result at scope lock.** The encoding is kit-faithful either way; only the reach depends on the comp.
⚑ Her kit gates the Pierce on '>80% HP', which is not encoded. There is no incoming damage at scope lock, so the gate is always satisfied and an ungated tag is exact here. Re-encode the gate if incoming damage is ever modeled.
⚑ S1's Charge Speed is modeled as a flat target-own buff, but the kit says '11.67% of the skill user's Charge Speed' — caster-relative, and no caster-relative charge-speed StatKey exists. OUT-OF-DOMAIN (engine-core primitive). At scope lock alice is at base charge speed unless she ranks top-2 ATK AND her own +80.15% burst buff is live at FB entry, in which case the flat 11.67 understates the grant by up to ~80% of 11.67 (~+9pp), on those rotations only — a low-single-digit-% cadence effect on the 2 targeted allies. Recipe: read the 2 targeted allies' charged-shot cadence in a focus video against the sim; if it disagrees, snapshot the caster's charge speed at FB entry.
UNMODELED: S2's below-80%-HP lifesteal ('continuously recover HP by 8.12% of attack damage'). OUT-OF-DOMAIN and exactly zero impact at scope lock — the boss deals no damage, no unit ever drops below the 80% gate, and there is no HP pool to heal, so the line can move no damage and emits no recovery event.

alice-wonderland-bunny.note: Alice: Wonderland Bunny (awb) — Tetra SMG Supporter, Water, Burst I (40s CD), variant of base alice (SR/Fire — a different unit). The burst-I rotation-reset enabler: her burst RE-ENTERS Burst Stage 1 (datamined burstMeta use_burst_skill/change_burst_step = Step1) so a second eligible B1 also casts in the same chain — engine reenterStage stage 1 (the Tia / Anis:Star pairing primitive; sim.ts stage-hold). skill1 (both lines fire 'after landing 60 normal attacks', one ■ header → one hitCount:60 trigger each): (1) team heal EVENT — 'Recovers 7.4% of the skill user's final Max HP': the heal effect emits a recovery event to all allies with no HP amount modeled (engine design), feeding recovery-trigger consumers (e.g. crown's 'when recovery takes effect' team Attack Damage); at her SMG cadence (RoF 1440, 120 mag) this fires ~every 2.5s. (2) Carrot Party — 'Damage to Interruption Parts ▲2%, stacks up to 5 time(s), lasts 5 sec': partsDamagePct 2 / maxStacks 5 / 5s, parsed but INERT in v1 (no destructible parts on the boss — the helm partsDamagePct precedent); carried at the event level so the magnitude/stacking are queryable. skill2: (1) 'after Full Burst ends → Burst Gauge filling speed ▲10% for 5 sec' = burstGenPct 10 / 5s on fullBurstEnd (NOT fullBurstEnter — the post-FB refill window, not the in-FB window); (2) 'entering Full Burst → Max Ammunition Capacity ▲40% for 15 sec' = maxAmmoPct 40 / 15s on fullBurstEnter (percent of capacity, NOT maxAmmoFlat rounds — weapon-state modifier, damage-relevant through reload economy); (3) 'Reload 40%' = instantReload fraction 0.4 on the same fullBurstEnter — an INSTANT partial magazine refill, NOT a reloadSpeedPct buff (the two-word line's nearest shared-prior misread). Block order within skill2 is load-bearing for the refill size: the maxAmmoPct block precedes the instantReload block, so the refill reads the raised capacity (0.4 × 168 ≈ 67 rounds at SL10) — both effects land on the same FB-entry frame, capacity-up first. ⚑ the in-game capacity-vs-refill ordering is unmeasured; if a recording shows 40% of BASE capacity (48 rounds) instead, swap the block order. burst: reenterStage stage 1 + team heal event ('Restores 27% of the skill user's final Max HP', amount unmodeled by engine design). skill1's 90-hit line 'Stack count of buffs ▲ 1' is MODELED as a +1 stack GRANT — hitCount:90 → alliesOfElement Water → `addStack` count 1 (enacted 2026-08-09, owner faithfulness ruling): the identical sentence family (word_group 10001) is read as a GRANT by the guilty/pepper/rupee/mica-snow-buddy majority and this override now aligns; ⚑ the minority stack-CAP-raise reading (the 2026-07-28 gauntlet's) stays on record — if a datamine function-type read or footage confirms cap-raise, revert to unmodeled (a cap raise has no primitive). In-fixture movement ≈ nil: the only stackable Water-ally buff is her own Carrot Party (partsDamagePct — partless-boss inert), which the grant merely accelerates toward its cap. UNMODELED: the burst's 'when Carrot Party is at max stacks → Incoming healing ▲150% for 15 sec' (no healing-received channel exists). ark-ranger-black.note:
Ark Ranger Black (ark-ranger-black), AR/Wind/Burst III/Tetra/Attacker, cd 40s, ammo 60.

BATTERY/TRANSFORMATION STATE MACHINE: the kit's central mechanic is a battery resource that charges from part destruction (S1 L2) and, at 100%, triggers Transformation (ATK ▲156.19% + Ark Black Collider DoT). Transformation drains battery at 1%/0.2s (5%/s) until 0%. In the scope-lock (partless boss), the part-destroy trigger NEVER fires, so the battery starts at 0 and the ONLY way to charge it is the burst's Emergency Charge Protocol (Battery ▲100% → Transformation → Battery ▼50% → battery=50% → drains at 5%/s → Transformation lasts 10s). The burst CD is 40s and Transformation lasts 10s, so the 'while in Transformation: Battery ▲50%' burst branch NEVER fires in scope-lock (the burst always fires outside Transformation). The effective model: every burst triggers a 10s Transformation window. The 10s is DATAMINED from the kit's own arithmetic: 50% battery / (1% per 0.2s) = 50% / 5%/s = 10s.

S1: partsDamagePct 20% (passive, inert vs partless boss — MEASURED inert by construction). hitCount:30 → sustainedDamagePct 59.6% for 5s (DATAMINED; at 720 RPM = 12 shots/s, fires every 2.5s; 5s duration → effectively permanent after first proc at t≈2.5s).

S2: fullBurstEnter → all Wind AR allies (includes self): sustainedDamagePct 77.5% for 10s (DATAMINED). Fires on EVERY team Full Burst (every ~20s in the control comp), not just when ark-ranger-black bursts.

BURST (burstCast trigger — fires only on rotations ark-ranger-black bursts, ~every 40s in the control comp with two B3 units):
- ATK ▲156.19% for 10s (self) — the Transformation ATK buff; 10s = battery drain time (DATAMINED derivation above). burstCast NOT fullBurstEnter: keyed to her own burst, so it does NOT fire on helm's bursts.
- Ark Black Collider: 45.87%/s sustained DoT on all enemies for 10s (DATAMINED; 'sustained damage every 1 sec until Transformation is canceled' = 10s DoT). flavor:'sustained' → routes through sustainedDamagePct bucket.
- 266.69%/s sustained DoT on highest-HP enemy for 10s (DATAMINED; independent of Transformation). flavor:'sustained'.
- sustainedDamagePct 135.83% for 10s (self, DATAMINED).

UNMODELED: S1 battery-charge-from-part-destroy (part-destroy trigger unsupported; inert in scope-lock). Burst 'while in Transformation: Battery ▲50%' branch (never fires in scope-lock — burst CD 40s > Transformation 10s). The battery resource itself is not modeled (no sim observable; the 10s Transformation window is the faithful encoding of its effect).

EVIDENCE TIERS: all magnitudes DATAMINED (kit text at skill level 10). 10s Transformation duration DATAMINED (derived from kit-stated drain rate + burst-stated 50% post-transform battery). No MEASURED values yet (no probe data). Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-24.

avistar.note: Avistar (avistar) — Elysion MG Supporter, Electric, Burst I (cd 20s, ammo 300, reloadFrames 171, RoF 60). A 'king-maker' B1 enabler in the Chime mold: she designates ONE ally as 'her favorite pop star' (word_group=10103) and pours her damage buffs into it, AND re-enters Burst Stage 1 so a second B1 can also cast each chain. FAVORITE-POP-STAR TARGETING: the single ally with the highest ATK, modeled as alliesTopAtk count:1 with STATIC base-ATK ranking (no byFinalAtk — the kit says plain 'her favorite pop star'/highest ATK, not 'final ATK', so the owner literal-word rule keeps base ranking; the designation is fixed at battle start, which matches the engine evaluating the ranking once — the chime 'the king' precedent). Datamined base ATK 500 puts Avistar above most B1 carries she is paired with (e.g. Anis: Star 400), so without excludeSelf the selector would resolve to Avistar herself; excludeSelf is ON so the buff lands on the intended carry. Whether the kit's 'ally' wording strictly excludes the caster is unverified (⚑, recipe: focus video showing which unit carries the favorite-pop-star icon, or the datamined target flag for word_group 10103). SKILL1 (Aftershow, 'Activates when Full Burst ends'): (L1) the favorite pop star gets ATK ▲80.26% OF AVISTAR'S OWN ATK as a flat add → casterAtkPct 80.26 on fullBurstEnd. NOTE the caster-basis: this is % of the SKILL USER's ATK (Avistar, a Supporter), NOT % of the carry's own ATK — atkPct would massively over-buff a high-ATK carry and is the nearest-wrong counterfactual (chime precedent). 'This effect is removed when entering Full Burst' is NOT enacted — the engine has no expire-on-FB-entry hook (fbGate gates APPLICATION at trigger time only, sim.ts `blockGatesPass()`; buffs expire purely by expiresFrame), so the grant is modeled permanent and the removal is a disclosed residual (⚑1). (L2) self heal 'Recovers 3.52% of the skill user's final Max HP as HP every 1 sec for 10 sec' → heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 on fullBurstEnd — a real unit-HP heal (icon icn_skill_heal_01), so it emits 10 recovery events over 10s (engine design: no HP amount modeled); self-targeted, so it fires only Avistar's OWN 'recovery' triggers (she has none) and does NOT feed teammate recovery-consumers (a SELF heal, unlike a team heal). Offensively inert for her own damage; modeled for kit-SSOT completeness + correct recovery-event emission. 'Removes Stargazer' (the S1 clause) is the lifecycle of the inert Stargazer Max HP buff (L8) — not a separate damage line, documented below. SKILL2 (Afterglow, 'Activates when entering Full Burst while in Stargazer status'): the favorite pop star gets (L5) Projectile Explosion Damage ▲40.13% + (L6) Attack Damage ▲40.13%, both 'continuously' → projectileExplosionPct 40.13 + attackDamagePct 40.13 on fullBurstEnter, NO durationSec (continuous = permanent once granted; re-triggered every FB entry → refreshed). STARGAZER GATE = ownBurstGate:'cast' (the load-bearing judgment, independently re-derived by the S2b blind reviewer): Stargazer is self-granted by her OWN burst and removed at FB end (by S1), so it is present at an FB-entry moment IF AND ONLY IF Avistar cast her own burst in the rotation leading into that FB. The engine's ownBurstGate:'cast' (sim.ts `blockGatesPass()`; fires the block only when the owner is in this rotation's burst casters) encodes that equivalence EXACTLY — a plain ungated fullBurstEnter would OVER-fire on any FB entered without her cast (e.g. her 20s CD not up, or a co-B1 carrying the chain), granting the 40.13 buffs with no Stargazer. On the happy path (she is the sole B1 and casts every rotation) the gate is always satisfied, so it is behaviorally identical to ungated there; it bites only in non-cast rotations (PINNED by the CD-bump discrimination in the spec). targetStatus CANNOT carry Stargazer (that channel is boss-only). projectileExplosionPct feeds only projectileExplosion-flavored damage (sim.ts `dealDamage()`, the flavor-scoped Damage-Up terms) — its damage YIELD requires an explosive-weapon carry (RL/explosive SR); on a non-explosive carry it is applied-but-inert (the attackDamagePct 40.13 is the always-live Damage-Up bucket). The S2 self line (L4) 'while in Stargazer status with over 25% HP → self: Current HP ▼20%' is UNMODELED (no HP pool in v1; the self-drain and its >25% HP gate move no damage). BURST (Stargazer, burstCast = her casts; B1 so the cast lands at chain START): (L7) all allies — Re-enters Burst Stage 1 → reenterStage stage:1 (the rotation HOLDS stage 1 after her cast so a second eligible B1 also casts this chain — the Tia/Anis:Star re-entry mechanic, sim.ts stage-hold; behaviorally live only when a 2nd B1 is present, else the stage advances — the real-kit no-op case). (L8) self — 'Stargazer: Max HP ▲26.4% of the skill user's Max HP continuously' → casterMaxHpPct 26.4, NO durationSec; OFFENSIVELY INERT (self Max HP does not feed any atkOfMaxHpPct consumer — Avistar has none; the anis-star e3-rule precedent), kept for kit-SSOT completeness. Her own MG normal damage is minor; her value is the favorite-pop-star buffs + the B1 re-entry, so a /sim-battery board diff is the real check. NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑1 (Aftershow removal clause, MATERIAL): the kit's 'removed when entering Full Burst' is NOT enacted — the engine has no expire-on-FB-entry hook (fbGate gates APPLICATION at trigger time only, sim.ts `blockGatesPass()`; buffs expire purely by expiresFrame), so the sim keeps the casterAtkPct 80.26 flat ATK on the favorite pop star PERMANENT instead of outFb-only. This OVER-credits the carry's FB-window damage (the flat ATK is present during FB when the real kit removes it). MEASURED bound: the Aftershow's TOTAL contribution is ~30% of the favorite pop star's damage (FIX_A permanent-vs-removed: ada 778.4M → 598.9M); the unenacted removal leaks the FB-window PORTION of that — estimated ~8-14% of the carry's damage (the flat add is a larger fraction of the carry's effective ATK outFb than in FB, so the FB-window slice is the minority of the ~30%, but still material), ~half that of the team total. Deliberately NOT a fudged durationSec: the outFb gap is comp-dependent (10s on a 20s rotation, 30s on a 40s rotation), so any fixed window is an unmeasured fabrication wrong in some comp; the permanent grant is the transparent upper bound and the over-credit is disclosed here rather than hidden behind false precision (gauntlet: 'measured > fudge', 'a blind honest ⚑ is correct'). Recipe: an expire-on-FB-entry engine hook enacts it exactly; a focus video reading the Aftershow-icon uptime on the carry (expected outFb-only) calibrates a window approximation. Tier 2. ⚑2 (MG cadence tuple, standard): ammo 300 / reloadFrames 171 / RoF 60 are the datamine (unverified for this unit); her self-damage is minor so the cadence is low-impact. Recipe: read fire cadence + the reload gap from any focus video. TIER 2: alliesTopAtk scoped buffs (favorite pop star), the Stargazer status-gate (ownBurstGate:'cast'), burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnd timing (S2 at FB entry, S1 at FB end), reenterStage (meta-defining B1 re-entry), and the Aftershow removal-clause engine residual. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01.

biscuit.note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01 (cross-family corroborated). Biscuit (`biscuit`, RL B2 Supporter Electric, ammo 6 / chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141): a support unit with NO damage line of her own — her kit is two CLASS-SCOPED buffs plus two CLASS-SCOPED heals, all keyed off the team rotation. S1 ('Activates at the END of Full Burst', all ATTACKER allies) = (B1) critRateNormalPct ▲5.77% for 10s + (B2) a heal-over-time (ticks:10, intervalSec:1) on trigger fullBurstEnd (the literal 'end of Full Burst', NOT fullBurstEnter — the 10s window opens as the FB window CLOSES), target alliesOfClass Attacker. critRateNormalPct is the normal-attack-scoped crit stat (helm S1 carrier; sim.ts joins it to the roll ONLY on normal-attack hits, so skill/burst buckets are untouched). Burst ('Walk Training', all SUPPORTER allies) = (B6) atkPct ▲43.08% for 10s + (B7) a lifesteal-over-time heal (ticks:10, intervalSec:1) on trigger burstCast, target alliesOfClass Supporter (reaches the other Supporter allies AND herself). THE TWO HEALS ARE MODELED as `heal` effects (NOT dropped), per the helm precedent (helm's burst 'recovers 54.45% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec' is a heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 that drives recovery consumers — scripts/tests/units/helm.test.ts H8) and the independent blind re-derivation (claude-fable-5 S2b converged on the recovery-stream encoding for both lines). A `heal` emits recovery events to its targets and fires THEIR 'recovery'-triggered blocks; the engine models no HP AMOUNT, so the heal's only sim content is that recovery channel. CRITICAL SCOPE GUARD: both heals are class-scoped (S1→Attacker, burst→Supporter) and so do NOT feed a DEFENDER recovery consumer — Crown's S2 'when recovery takes effect → team ATK ▲20.99%' is the canonical consumer and is a Defender, exactly the class biscuit's heals exclude. This is the inverse of the liter cover-HP trap (owner ruling 2026-07-21): liter's cover-restore was dropped because cover-HP is NOT a unit heal and was spuriously firing Crown; biscuit's lines ARE genuine unit heals but are scoped AWAY from Defenders, so they fire only matching-class consumers (e.g. asuka, an Attacker 'on-recovery → self ATK ▲96.98%' carrier, fed by S1) and never Crown. SLUG chisato — Chisato, SMG / Burst III / Attacker / Iron, ammo 120, reloadFrames 81, normalMult 10.12, coreMult 250, burstCd 40s. Board: 0.968 COLD on 3 graded comps (0.95 / 0.96 / 0.99). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/chisato.test.ts (20 pins); the open levers are the derived Extrasensory drain, the hit-rate magnitude, and the cadence tuple, all ⚑ below.
EXTRASENSORY (self-status proxy — classification: BOUNDED-APPROXIMATION, exact under her graded cadence). The kit charges it to 100% at battle start, drains it 1%/2s (0.5%/s), and her OWN burst recharges it to 100%. From 100% the >70% ATK 53.69 / >55% True Damage 48.62 / >25% Hit Rate 22.37 gates cross their thresholds at t≈60 / 90 / 150s. Encoded as FUSED PASSIVES — a passive buff honors an explicit durationSec, so each is live from frame 0 and expires at 60 / 90 / 150s — PLUS a burstCast skill1 block that re-applies all three (same buff keys, so they refresh) on every one of her own casts. One model reproduces both regimes: when she bursts each rotation the refresh beats the shortest fuse and all gates stay permanently cleared; in never-burst comps they correctly lapse at 60 / 90 / 150s. On her graded comps she casts at t≈3.6 / 33.7 / 63.3 / 93.7 / 124.5 / 155.0s (~30s apart, inside the 60s ATK fuse), so the decay is inert there and only bites in under-burst comps such as N2 modernia-wind, where modernia takes the B3 slot. The fused-passive trajectory is equivalent to a literal Extrasensory resource pool — same observable lapse ladder. ⚑ the 0.5%/s drain and the gate thresholds are DERIVED from kit text, not measured; the crossing times are exact GIVEN the drain rate, and the drain rate is the kit's own stated 1%/2s.
NOT ENCODED (folded into the derivation or genuinely skippable): the battle-start charge line and the 1%/2s drain line are currency bookkeeping the fuse durations already express; the burst's 'Charges Extrasensory to 100%' is the refresh block; the 100%-only 'Dodging Bullets: Invulnerable 2 sec' is invulnerability, inert with no HP pool.
HIT RATE 22.37 is modeled as hitRatePct and is LIVE via CONE_DELTA — it feeds her SMG core rate through acrForHR. In-game magnitude ⚑.
S2. (a) 'Normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec' on burstCast = a same-weapon weaponSwap, damagePct 10.12 (exactly her own normal multiplier, so the gun is unchanged) + trueNormals, 10s — the takina-precedent encoding. The flavor gate is the point: it makes her permanent S1 trueDamagePct 48.62 apply to normals ONLY inside the window (≈+48.62% damage-up on ~10s of every 40s of normals). The swap carries sameWeapon:true, the engine's 'the gun is not replaced' marker, so it does NOT refill the mag at either end — no swap-start refill, no free reload on exit — and the window carries no shot-count optimism. (b) hitCount-48 → 472.18% flatDamage, flavor 'true', FB-by-timing (no noFb), permanently boosted by the flavor-gated 48.62.
TRUE DAMAGE IS A FLAVOR, NOT A PROPERTY CHANGE (owner ruling 2026-08-13, general — it governs every trueFlavor swap, not just hers): it works like pierce, changing the flavor of the damage rather than its properties, so a WEAPON dealing true damage can crit AND core, while a SKILL dealing true damage can crit but NOT core. Her normals are the WEAPON case — the trueNormals swap rides the normal-fire path, so they crit and core exactly like her untrue normals, which is correct and no longer a ⚑. Skill-sourced true damage cores only if an effect authors an explicit coreRate, and none does; the roster-wide invariant is pinned in scripts/tests/true-damage-flavor-guard.test.ts.
BURST: her own burstCast, self atkPct 73.16, 10s.
⚑ CADENCE TUPLE: SMG class pullsPerSec + reloadFrames 81 + rolling reload are datamined, not measured; a 120-round mag at class rate is ≈9-10s, plausible, with no escalation tells.
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured charFixes.pullsPerSec, so the engine's swap-cadence branch resolves to her ordinary SMG class default. The 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her.
RAMP: she has no stack-ramp line. Her S1 gates are at full value from t=0 because the KIT charges Extrasensory to 100% at the start of battle, so the t=0 full-value encoding is kit-exact, not a bake-at-cap approximation.

crust.note: Crust — Water RL Supporter, Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 / chargeFrames 60 (datamine). STANCE-MODE MACHINE (mutually exclusive): her kit toggles between Maillard (entered in game by landing 3 normal non-Full-Charge attacks) and Blanching (entered by maintaining 3 Full Charges for >1 sec); each stance REMOVES the other. LOAD-BEARING PREMISE (verified sim.ts's charge-release path, `isAutofireCharge` + probe 2026-07-31): the engine's RL/SR path ALWAYS fires full-charge shots (firePull(...,true) on every charge cycle; an RL never tap-fires), so the '3 normal non-Full-Charge → Maillard' entry can NEVER fire in-sim and Blanching is the ONLY reachable stance. The default mode is therefore BLANCHING (the sim-faithful state); a default run grants the burst's Sustained ▲10% and NEVER the Distributed ▲60%. Maillard is kept as a documented OPT-IN mode for modeling a real tap-fire / distributed-team playstyle (its buff payload — incl. the 60% Distributed burst — is real kit information), with the caveat that the sim's RL cadence full-charges regardless of the selected mode; selecting Maillard represents a player-behaviour override, not the sim's default cadence. The engine has no attack-pattern / stance-entry event primitive, so the live stance is a user-selectable `modes` pair [Blanching, Maillard]. Both stances grant the SAME S1 ATK buff (▲10% of caster ATK to all allies), so that line is unconditional across modes; only the burst's conditional damage buff discriminates the two stances. S1 STANCE ATK: 'ATK ▲10% of the skill user's ATK' = casterAtkPct 10 (a FLAT grant derived from the CASTER's staticAtk, identical absolute amount on every ally regardless of their own ATK — NOT atkPct which scales each target's own ATK). Modeled as a hitCount:3 trigger per stance (fires every 3 of crust's hits; RL hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ 3 full-charge shots ≈ 4.1s in, then re-procs every ~3 shots against the 10s window ⇒ saturated ~100% uptime after the opening proc); one mode-gated block per stance documents the two distinct entry conditions while the mode gate enforces their mutual exclusivity. The kit's '>1 sec maintain Full Charge' dwell qualifier is NOT modeled (the engine releases at full charge + release latency) — ⚑ convention: every sim full-charge shot counts as qualifying. S2 FB-ENTRY ATK: 'entering Full Burst → all targets in Maillard or Blanching → ATK ▲20% of the skill user's ATK /10s' = fullBurstEnter casterAtkPct 20 to all allies; a stance is always active (one of the two modes), so the 'in Maillard or Blanching' qualifier is ungated. BURST: 'all allies Attack Damage ▲20%/10s' = burstCast attackDamagePct 20 (ungated, lands on the cast frame BEFORE the FB window); 'all allies in Maillard Distributed Damage ▲60%/10s' = burstCast distributedDamagePct 60 mode-gated Maillard (feeds each ally's distributed-flavor hits ×1.6, sim.ts distributed bucket); 'all allies in Blanching Sustained Damage ▲10%/10s' = burstCast sustainedDamagePct 10 mode-gated Blanching (additive Damage-Up on sustained-flavor hits). The Distributed/Sustained buffs are granted to all allies but only move damage on distributed/sustained-flavor hits — inert at ×1 in comps without such hits (correct engine behaviour, not a gap). UNMODELED (all in `unmodeled`, no silent drops): S1 L1/L2 'Duration ▲2.5 sec' (a buff-duration-extension maintenance line — the stance ATK buff is modeled at saturated uptime, so extending its duration moves no damage; no generic duration-extend primitive); S1 'Removes Blanching'/'Removes Maillard' (mutual exclusivity enforced STRUCTURALLY by the single selected mode); S2 'Affects all allies not in Reliable Cooking status' (no-refresh gate — the engine has no 'apply only if absent' target filter; the model refreshes instead, inert while defPct is inert) and 'Removes 1 debuff' (no cleanse primitive; the scope-lock boss applies no ally debuffs). S2 RELIABLE COOKING DEF: 'DEF ▲10% of the skill user's DEF /10s' IS encoded as an inert defPct 10 block (hitCount:3, all allies, 10s) for kit completeness — ⚑ the kit is CASTER-DEF-derived but there is no casterDefPct StatKey, so it is approximated by the target's own defPct; defPct is inert for damage in v1 (self DEF does not feed own damage), so the approximation moves nothing today (a future DEF consumer would need a casterDefPct StatKey, not a retune). ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED: the full cadence tuple (charge 60 / reload 141) is a datamine estimate; stance-entry timing (first qualifying attack pattern, not t=0) and the '>1s maintain' dwell are folded into the hitCount:3 convention and unmeasured; which stance a real team holds is a player-behaviour choice the sim cannot auto-derive (pick the mode matching the recording). | Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-31: encoding authored test-first (scripts/tests/units/crust.test.ts) and reconciled cross-family — S1 stance ATK casterAtkPct 10 (hitCount:3, both stances, flat-from-caster discriminated vs atkPct), S2 Reliable Cooking defPct 10 (hitCount:3, inert), S2 FB-entry casterAtkPct 20 (fullBurstEnter, uncond), burst attackDamagePct 20 (burstCast, uncond), burst distributedDamagePct 60 (Maillard-gated), burst sustainedDamagePct 10 (Blanching-gated). S2b (claude-fable-5) verified the RL-always-full-charge premise ⇒ Blanching default; S5/S6 (claude-opus-5) blind re-derivations converged on modes [Blanching,Maillard], the casterAtkPct flat scaling, hitCount:3 stance trigger, inert defPct, fullBurstEnter S2, and the burstCast burst aura; corroboration recorded in scripts/kit-autonomy/results/crust.json.

elegg-boom-and-shock.note: GHOST-CURRENCY UNIT — Water MG Attacker B3, slug elegg-boom-and-shock (the Water VARIANT; NOT the base Electric `elegg`). MODEL: the ghost count is a LIVE RESOURCE POOL 'ghost' {initial 0, min 0, max 13} (engine resource-counter primitive — same family as soda-twinkling-bunny's Golden Chip / marciana's Whistle). ACCRUAL = +1 ghost every 6s (interval:6 -> resource +1): this honors the kit's 'Recurring interval: 6 sec' as a capture CAP (<=1 ghost/6s; the 100-cumulative-team-hit gate is folded as clearing inside 6s for a full team — ⚑1). The whole ghost trajectory is EMERGENT: pool peaks ~7 while bursting on cooldown (so the burst is the 6-hit branch and the cap nuke fires 0x), and ramps 0->13 by t~78 in a never-burst context. S1 >=1 ghost -> Water allies casterAtkPct 16.2 (~permanent from t~6). S1 >=4 ghosts -> Water allies elemAdvantageDamagePct 35 (live while pool>=4; partial-uptime bursting, ~permanent from t~24 never-burst). S2 on burst -> self atkPct 40 /10s (burstCast). S2 nuke -> 1100% flatDamage to the enemy while AT cap (resourceGate ghost>=13). Burst !=13 branch -> burstCast + resourceGate ghost<=12 -> SIX discrete 800% flatDamage sequential hits + resource -6. Burst =13 branch -> burstCast + resourceGate ghost>=13 -> THIRTEEN discrete 800% flatDamage sequential hits + resource -9 (provably reachable: engineered pool=13 -> first burst fires 13 hits then -9->4). Branch gates read the PRE-spend pool; the !=13 block is ordered FIRST so the =13 spend cannot also open it. Burst hits are DISCRETE (not consolidated to 4800/10400) per the literal 'Attacks sequentially for N time(s)'. THRESHOLD-GATED BUFF ENCODING: the engine primes `passive` blocks once in its frame-0 pass and never re-evaluates their resourceGate, so the >=1/>=4 tier buffs and the at-cap nuke are gated on the live pool via a teamAmmo count:100 trigger + resourceGate + durationSec:6 — the teamAmmo trigger is a FREQUENT POOL-CHECK (fires each time the team consumes 100 rounds), NOT the accrual cadence; it re-reads the interval-accrued pool and applies the gated buff/nuke while the pool qualifies (the dur bridges checks and lapses ~6s after the pool drops below threshold — a ⚑ lag). WHY EVENT-DRIVEN POOL-CHECKS: threshold-gated `interval` blocks perturb the team-generator beam-search invariant (scripts/tests/generators/burst-cooldown-coverage.ts topTeams(5)) even at BYTE-IDENTICAL damage — proven structural, not a damage regression (a single interval:6 accrual block is tolerated; a second interval block re-perturbs). So the accrual stays interval:6 (the faithful 6s cap) and only the pool-CHECKS are event-driven (teamAmmo), which lands cleanly. ⚑1 CAPTURE CADENCE (TOP residual): accrual is interval:6 (the 'Recurring interval: 6 sec' cap reading; pool peaks ~7 bursting, nuke 0x bursting, ~17 nuke procs from t~78 never-burst at the accrual cadence). The ALTERNATIVE teamAmmo:100 ACCRUAL reading (treat the 100-hit gate as binding, no 6s cap -> pool pins near 13, burst mostly 13-hit, nuke frequent — a 1.7x HOT over-credit on the board) is rejected here as the less-faithful cadence; resolve from footage (ghost-counter UI delta: time-to-13 never-burst ~78s => the 6s cap binds). The no-burst NUKE cadence here is teamAmmo-triggered (fires per 100 rounds at cap, more often than the per-capture accrual) — a ⚑ over-fire vs strict per-capture; the FIRST nuke at t~78 is correct, the count is cadence-dependent. teamAmmo counts ROUNDS consumed not landed hits (SG pellets/misses diverge) and ignores infinite-ammo shots. ⚑2 MG CADENCE TUPLE (mandatory): pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 171 datamine-unverified. ⚑3 ELEM-ADVANTAGE magnitude is live ONLY under elemental advantage (Water vs a Fire boss = live; inert vs a non-disadvantaged/neutral boss — verify boss element when grading). NUKE OFF-BY-ONE (low, 0 board impact): the min:13 gate reads the POST-add pool, so the capture that takes the pool 12->13 may fire one nuke the strict 'captured WHILE AT maximum capacity' wording does not grant. 'Maintains at least 1 ghost' is MODELED as pool min:1 (enacted 2026-08-09, owner faithfulness ruling): resource init is NOT clamped — pools start at `initial` 0 and min/max clamp only delta adjustments (sim.ts) — so min:1 floors the burst spend at 1 ghost without lighting frame-0 gates; it binds only when the pool is ≤6 at cast. Both burst branches' 800% hits are UNTAGGED for burstDesc (owner ruling 2026-08-10 — the Burst-Skill-Damage amps are LITERAL-ONLY: trina's Spread Roots amplifies 'skills with "Affects all enemies"' and jackal's names '"Affects 1 enemy unit(s)" in the description', so a clause that paraphrases the meaning does not qualify; 'Affects random enemy units if the number of ghosts is …' is not that string, so no burst-skill-damage amp reaches them; dormant today, no amp carrier shares her comps). Rider crit ships at the engine flatDamage default (unset); the SSOT states function-type damage crits at the caster's rate by default — verify/align repo-wide before changing.

emilia.name: Emilia

findings: kit-tdd test-first build 2026-08-03 (NOT a gauntlet run): all 7 kit lines dispositioned, spec at scripts/tests/units/emilia.test.ts (19 green / 3 skipped GAPs). Required a new engine primitive, hitRepeat (%-of-hit repeat), for S2's 'Fixed Damage equal to 58.99% of the damage dealt by self' — the line that made her NO-GO(engine-core) on 2026-08-02. Two GAPs remain skipped: the burst's Charge Speed 300% downside, and both S1 round-count buffs being consumed by their own triggering pull (docs/engine-modeling-gaps.md theme 21, 4 carriers). No recorded fight exists, so nothing here is board-validated.

burst: Explosion Range ▲ 101.24% for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ BOTH S1 EFFECTS ARE CURRENTLY INERT — engine gap, not an encoding choice (docs/engine-modeling-gaps.md theme 21). 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge ... for 1 round(s)' means 'buff my NEXT round', which the engine cannot express: firePull dispatches a pull's shotFired blocks and then, later in the SAME pull, decrements every round-scoped buff the unit holds — including the one that pull just applied. A shotFired + durationShots:1 buff therefore reaches zero rounds. Proven by counterfactual on the control comp: with durationShots 1 her charge bucket only ever reads {2.5, 15.5053} and she fires 116 shots; bumping ONLY durationShots to 2 yields {2.5, 2.6206, 15.6259} and 128 shots. That counterfactual is re-runnable — scripts/tests/units/emilia.test.ts, the 'theme 21 ... CANARY' block, which also fails the moment the gap closes so this caveat cannot go stale unnoticed. The encoding here is the faithful one and matches the roster's prior art (zwei, phantom and vesti-tactical-upgrade all pair shotFired with the literal kit round count and lose the same round); durationShots:2 would be a fudge meaning 'the next TWO rounds'. ESTIMATE while it stands: she is COLD by roughly the whole S1 contribution — ~10% fewer shots (116 vs 128) and a charge bucket of 2.5 instead of 2.6206 on ordinary shots (-4.6%), so on the order of -12% to -15% of her total. RECIPE: skip the round-count decrement for buffs applied on the frame being decremented (e.g. record an appliedFrame on the buff entry); it moves four units, so it is a batched engine change with its own board A/B, not an override edit.

⚑ S1 Charge Damage is encoded STATIC at 12.06 (= 2.01 x her base Max Ammunition Capacity of 6). The kit scales by LIVE 'final Max Ammunition Capacity', which is 9 while S2's +3 window is up, so the faithful value inside a Full Burst is 18.09 — a +6.03pp charge-bucket shortfall there. No primitive scales a buff by the computed maxAmmo(): `perResource` reads named resource pools, not a derived stat. ESTIMATE: the charge bucket reads 2.6206 instead of 2.6809 on shots inside the 10s window (-2.25% on those hits); the window covers roughly a quarter of a 180s fight, so whole-fight ~-0.5%. RECIPE: a `perMaxAmmo: { mult }` buff source read live in sim.ts stat(), or a resource pool mirroring maxAmmo(). The encoding is ALSO basis-specific — it assumes base ammo 6 with no cube/overload ammo lines, which is the scope-lock basis but not the web app's OL configurations; scripts/tests/units/emilia.test.ts pins the arithmetic against characters.json so it cannot drift unnoticed.

The burst's 'Charge Speed ▼ 300%' is MODELED, as chargeSpeedPct -300 with durationShots 1 alongside the +1300.53 Charge Damage in the same burstCast block — the kit pairs them as one Function ('Decreases Charge Speed and increases Charge Damage for 1 shot(s)'). Charge Speed is subtractive on charge TIME in this engine, so -300 means the nuke's charge takes 60 x (1 - (-300)/100) = 240 frames instead of 60: a real downside, correctly costed, not an approximation.

⚑ The S2 rider generates one skill-damage impact of burst gauge, the engine-wide treatment of function damage (flatDamage procs and DoT ticks; MEASURED for maiden-ice-rose's per-shot rider). Whether a %-of-hit repeat specifically generates energy is UNMEASURED. ESTIMATE: it roughly doubles her per-shot gauge contribution, so a wrong call here moves full-burst timing rather than her damage. RECIPE: a focus recording of emilia — count full bursts over the fixed 180s, or read the gauge-bar slope, against the same cadence.

⚑ CADENCE TUPLE (ALWAYS-⚑): chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6 shipped from the datamine, plus the engine-wide 22-frame release latency (her weapon's input_type is 'UP', so she is not an autofire-charge unit). RECIPE: rounds-per-minute plus the reload gap off any focus video.

The burst's Explosion Range ▲101.24% is splash RADIUS, for which there is no primitive, and it is inert against the single partless scope-lock boss (nothing to splash onto). Recorded verbatim in `unmodeled` rather than approximated with a damage stat.

Slug is unique; approved nickname 'emi'. Every magnitude below is kit-text-literal, read from data/characters.json — the blablalink prose plus the datamined role.skillDetails level arrays at index 9 (skill level 10). || MODELED TODAY. S1 'Lesser Spirit's Blessing' (one block, '■ Activates when attacking with Full Charge. Affects self.'): (a) Charge Speed ▲13.01% 'for 1 round(s)' -> shotFired -> self, durationShots 1. An RL trigger pull IS one full charge in this engine (a charge weapon always dispatches charged=true), which is why shotFired is the full-charge trigger — the same encoding maiden-ice-rose's full-charge rider uses. (b) 'Charge Damage ▲2.01% for every unit in the final Max Ammunition Capacity' -> chargeDamagePct 12.06 (2.01 x base ammo 6), durationShots 1 — a static approximation of a live-Max-Ammo scaling, see caveats. That is an engine gap with its own batched fix across four carriers, not something this file can correct — full estimate and recipe in `caveats`, cross-unit thread in docs/engine-modeling-gaps.md theme 21. S2 'Great Spirit's Mace': (a) '■ Activates when hitting a target with Full Charge. Affects target(s). Deals Fixed Damage to the main body equal to 58.99% of the damage dealt by self' -> shotFired -> enemy -> hitRepeat pct 58.99. This is a '%-of-hit repeat' (docs/data/nikke-damage-formula.md §3): the rider deals 58.99% of the parent hit's FINAL damage and inherits that hit's crit expectation, core, element, Damage-Up and Full-Burst state IMPLICITLY, by being a fraction of an already-composed number — it applies no multiplier of its own, so it never takes a second core and never takes the +30% range bonus. It is her largest sustained contribution and rides the burst nuke as well. Folding it into chargeDamagePct is NOT equivalent: the rider is multiplicative on the whole parent while the charge bucket is additive, so any constant that is right on an ordinary shot is badly wrong on the nuke (her burst adds +1300.53 charge points). (b) '■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. Max Ammunition Capacity ▲3 round(s) for 10 sec' -> fullBurstEnter -> self -> maxAmmoFlat 3, durationSec 10 (theme-14 flat round-count precedent: grave/noir/tove/drake/trina); it acts through the reload refill, so she leaves the window's reloads with a 9-round magazine. Burst 'Freezing Witch' ('■ Affects self.') is ONE burstCast -> self block carrying both halves of its Function ('Decreases Charge Speed and increases Charge Damage for 1 shot(s)'), each durationShots 1: chargeSpeedPct -300 and chargeDamagePct 1300.53. The Charge Damage is an ordinary ADDITIVE charge-bucket buff, not a base-scaling chargeDamageMultPct, so exactly one shot per cast fires at charge 2.5 + 1300.53/100 (plus S1b's 12.06 once the theme-21 gap closes). The Charge Speed is a genuine downside, correctly costed: charge speed is subtractive on charge TIME here, so that one shot charges for 240 frames instead of 60. || NOT MODELED (verbatim in `unmodeled`, never an `ignored` drop): the burst's Explosion Range ▲101.24% — splash radius, for which there is no primitive, and inert against a single partless boss. || EVIDENCE TIER: every live value is kit-text-literal (datamined level arrays), none fitted. She is in no graded comp and no recording exists, so nothing here is board-validated. TIER 2 (round-count durations on three of five modeled effects; a burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter split within one skill; a meta-defining single-shot charge nuke). Faithful > fit; measured > fudge.

caveats: ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED (tier 2): S1-L3 'Normal attacks deal true damage continuously' — the FLAVOR CHANGE of her sustained SR normals to true damage is UNMODELED. The engine's only true-normal mechanism is weaponSwap.trueNormals, which is (a) windowed (needs a durationSec) and (b) cannot coexist with her burst cannon swap (the engine holds a single swap slot — a fight-length trueNormals swap would be clobbered by the cannon swap on every burst and never restore). There is also no camouflage SELF-status to gate it (the engine has no self-status channel). Estimate: as shipped, her sustained SR normals stay NON-true, so the self trueDamagePct 42.24 buff is near-inert outside the burst cannon shot (it pays off fully on the cannon, which IS true-flavored); the kit intends ~camouflage-uptime fraction of her main SR DPS to be true-flavored and amplified. Camouflage uptime is partial (5s per 20s burst + Full-Charge-during-Full-Burst refreshes, roughly half the fight). Recipe: a permanent trueNormals flag that survives weapon-swap coexistence + a camouflage-uptime model (or a targetStatus-proxied camouflage window driving a windowed trueNormals swap), then popup-read the true-damage popup count / camouflage uptime in an eunhwa-tu recording. The trueDamagePct 42.24 buff itself is encoded and exact for the cannon payoff.

⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED (tier 2): the burst cannon swap DURATION is kit-silent — the kit gives 'Max Ammunition Capacity: 1 round' but states neither a 'for N sec' window nor 'deactivates when all rounds fired'. Estimate: durationSec 10 (the Full-Burst-window convention shared with e-h / red-hood); the 1-round magazine cycles over that window (fire / 141f reload / fire …) for ~6 true-damage cannon shots per burst. A shorter real window fires fewer shots (damage is roughly linear in shot count: 10s ≈ 6 shots ≈ double the single-shot reading). Recipe: an eunhwa-tu recording — count cannon popups per burst and the frame her base SR fire resumes; rescale durationSec to match.

burst: 'Damage Taken ▲27.87% for 10s' is an ON-HIT rider of the cannon shots (fullCharge + swapGate:'swapped'), so it lands on the first cannon shot (~0.3s after cast) and refreshes per subsequent shot — ~96% team uptime across the fight. The first cannon shot of each burst does NOT benefit (the debuff applies AFTER that shot's damage resolves, the per-pull trigger convention), faithful to 'target(s) hit'.

burst: on swap exit (durationSec expiry) the engine forces an empty-belt reload before SR fire resumes — the shared weaponSwap exit convention (e-h / snow-white-heavy-arms), not an ETU-specific choice; the in-game weapon-restore timing at swap deactivation is unmeasured.

skill2: the S2 bonus 'when applying LT Formation to self' is gated on emma-tactical-upgrade presence via teamHas.slugs (auto, presence ≡ formation applied). emma-tu's MIRROR bonus ('when applying AS Formation to self') is behind a manual mode on emma-tu (default OFF) — an asymmetry in the landed encodings: ETU's bonus auto-fires with emma-tu present, emma-tu's requires selecting its AS mode. Reconcile to a single auto-gate convention if both sisters grade a team together.
eunhwa-tactical-upgrade.note: Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade (slug eunhwa-tactical-upgrade, aka eunwhatu — variant of base eunhwa; never the bare base name, P0 disambiguation) — Elysion Fire SR Attacker, Burst II, 20s CD, 6-round SR (69.04% normal / 250% FC). FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-07-27 (no prior override; baseline was bare weapon, simSupported:false). S2 AS FORMATION (unconditional passives, 'activates only when self survives' = unconditional, no death in v1): E1 Critical Rate ▲8.16% 'all allies from the same squad' encoded as plain allies — the sim fields exactly ONE deployed squad, so same-squad ≡ the whole team (anchor-innocent-maid / emma-tu precedent; distinct from noir's teamHas.slugs gate on NAMED lore-mates, which is a gate not a target set); E2 Charge Damage ▲41.81% all allies (chargeDamagePct, additive ppt in the charge bucket); E3 ATK ▲42.24% self (atkPct). S2 BONUS 'when applying LT Formation to self' (E1 Projectile Explosion Damage ▲5.11%, E2 True Damage ▲30.97%, all allies): LT Formation is applied by emma-tactical-upgrade (MG/Fire/B1), whose own AS-Formation bonus is the mirror interaction. Encoded behind teamHas.slugs:['emma-tactical-upgrade'] — an AUTO composition gate (presence ≡ formation applied: both formations are unconditional in-game passives), per the emma-tu override note's explicit recommendation ('prefer a teamHas.slugs auto-gate over the manual mode'). emma-tu IS simSupported, so a board team CAN field both sisters and the bonus is board-live (not a dead mode). projectileExplosionPct feeds only explosion-flavored hits and (projExplOnRlNormals default ON) RL NORMAL attacks — inert on ETU's SR normals, live on an RL teammate's normals. S1 CAMOUFLAGE SCARF: the two Camouflage lines (on Burst use; on Full Charge during Full Burst — 'prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for 5s, removed on a direct hit') are DEFENSIVE and UNMODELED — v1 has a single immortal boss and no targeting model, so target-prevention moves no damage. The third S1 line 'Activates only when in Camouflage status: Normal attacks deal true damage continuously; True Damage ▲42.24% continuously' splits in two: the True Damage ▲42.24% buff IS encoded (self trueDamagePct 42.24, windowed to the Camouflage uptime — see below); the 'normal attacks deal true damage continuously' FLAVOR CHANGE is UNMODELED+FLAGGED (see caveats) — the engine's only true-normal mechanism is weaponSwap.trueNormals, which is windowed and cannot coexist with her burst cannon swap (single swap slot), and there is no camouflage SELF-status to gate it (the engine has no self-status channel, asuka-wille precedent). The 42.24 buff is modeled as a WINDOWED self buff that tracks the Camouflage uptime the engine CAN represent: it is applied on her OWN burstCast for 5s (S1-L1 'Camouflage for 5 sec') and REFRESHED on every full charge she lands DURING Full Burst (fullCharge + fbGate:'inFb', 5s — S1-L2), so it stays live across her in-FB burst cannon volley (each cannon shot is an in-FB full charge that refreshes it). This is the co-extensive-window construction the engine forces (no self-status gate exists; requiresTargetStatus is boss-only) — the nearest-wrong model is a permanent frame-0 passive ('continuously' misread as whole-fight), which the unit test discriminates against (multiple windowed applications with finite expiry, re-applied per in-FB full charge, NOT once per Full Burst). trueDamagePct pays off ONLY on true-flavored hits, and her sustained base SR normals are NOT true-flavored (the unmodeled flavor change above), so the buff is inert on them and pays off solely on her true-flavored burst cannon shots (~6 per burst). There is therefore no always-on over-credit; the residual error is an UNDER-count — the kit intends the camouflage-uptime fraction of her base SR DPS to also be true-flavored and amplified (the ⚑ below). BURST 'Explosive Round' (ChangeWeapon): weaponSwap to a 1-round true-damage cannon — damagePct 105.6 ('105.6% of final ATK as true damage'), chargeMultPct 300 ('Full Charge damage: 300% of damage' = ×3 on the 105.6, i.e. ~316.8% ATK per full charge — a multiplier on the swap's own damage, NOT +300 additive charge% and NOT 300% of ATK), chargeTimeSec 0.3 ('Charge time: 0.3 sec'), maxAmmo 1 ('Max Ammunition Capacity: 1 round'), trueNormals:true (the shots are true-flavored, so the trueDamagePct buffs pay off on them). The cannon is a REAL weapon change — no sameWeapon marker — so it takes the magazine refill at both ends: she enters the window on the cannon's 1-round magazine (not on however many SR rounds she happened to be carrying, which used to let her fire a whole SR magazine's worth of cannon shots before the first reload — worth -21% on her total) and her base SR is handed back full on exit. The kit states NEITHER a swap duration NOR 'deactivates when all rounds fired' (unlike e-h, whose kit says the latter and so uses maxShots:1) — so the 1-round magazine CYCLES over the swap window (fire / reload 141f / fire …), firing ~6 cannon shots per burst at ~0.3s charge + ~2.35s reload each. durationSec:10 is the Full-Burst-window convention (e-h / red-hood precedent) and is ⚑ kit-silent (see caveats). 'Explosive Round: Damage Taken ▲27.87% for 10s' is an ON-HIT rider of the cannon shots ('Target: Target(s) hit') — boss damageTakenPct 27.87 / 10s on fullCharge gated swapGate:'swapped', so it applies on the first cannon shot's landing and REFRESHES per subsequent cannon shot (~96% team uptime across the fight, vs ~67% for a cast-once encoding). The 'Fires an Exploding Bullet dealing area-of-effect damage' splash radius is inert vs the single partless boss (unmodeled). Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5, S5/S6 claude-opus-5, S7 kimi-code/k3. THE S2 CHAIN — why `stageEnter{stage:2}` is the faithful trigger for two HP-worded kit lines, with no HP pool and no boss damage required: S1's third line grants Peace-of-Mind allies 'Max HP ▲ 15.01% of the skill user's max HP (WITHOUT restoring HP) for 2 sec' on entering Burst Stage 2; because current HP does not rise with max HP, each affected ally's HP FRACTION drops that instant to 1/1.1501 = 86.95%, i.e. below 90% -> S2-1's 'HP of an adjacent ally drops to 90% or below' is satisfied AT stage-2 entry, so the shield lands there; the shield landing on Flora herself satisfies S2-3's 'a shield is placed in front of this unit' on the same frame; and 2 sec later the Max HP grant expires, the allies' max HP returns to normal and they are therefore AT max HP -> S2-2's 'either adjacent ally reaches max HP' fires at stage-2 entry + 2 sec (`delaySec: 2`). `stageEnter{stage:2}` is therefore a DERIVED-DETERMINISTIC PROXY for the HP-threshold clause, not a re-trigger of a different kit line: the HP transition it stands in for is caused by Flora's own S1 on exactly that frame, every rotation, in every team — no boss damage, no other healer and no HP pool are involved. The 2-sec offset is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: Full Burst opens ~0.87 s after Burst Stage 2 entry (30f B2->B3 + 22f B3->FB), so a 10-sec buff starting at +0 s vs +2 s covers a materially different slice of the Full Burst window. UNMODELED (verbatim lines in `unmodeled`, each with a structured caveat below): skill1 'Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks 5x' (no incomingHealingPct stat + no HP pool -> doubly inert); skill1's Max HP ▲ 15.01% grant is not modeled AS A STAT (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, e3 video rule, and 'without restoring HP' emits no recovery event) — but it is NOT damage-neutral, because it is the mechanism that fires the whole S2 chain above, which IS modeled. KIT-TEXT PROVENANCE: magnitudes are read from the blablalink prose SSOT (data/characters.json characters.flora.skills). The datamined `role.skillDetails` tables corroborate 90% / 10.22 / 30.97 / 10.45 / 42.39 / 100 attacks / 4% but are a PARTIAL capture of this kit — they omit S1's Burst-Stage-2 Max HP line, S2's shield->ATK line and the burst's ATK ▲ 85.86% line entirely, and they give the S2 True Damage duration as 5 sec where the prose says 10 sec. SIDES: S1's HoT and S2-3 both use selfAndAdjacent(sides 2) — they must agree, since 'the Peace of Mind state' IS the S1 target set. Whether `sides` should be 1 (self + one ally each side, which is how the prose 'self and both adjacent allies' reads) rather than 2 is a cross-unit question shared with `rouge`, filed in docs/open-questions.md; it is not settled here. The 'max stacks of Sleepy' precondition is satisfied by construction: Sleepy stacks once per FC hit (S1-L1), so 5 FCs bring max stacks and the 6-FC count lands on a max-stack target (the 10s stack duration outlasts her ~7.85s FC cycle — stacks never lapse mid-cycle). countInFb:6 is EXPLICIT because the chargeCounter default is countInFb ?? 1 within 10s of the owner's OWN burst cast (the SBS lowered-threshold semantics, sim.ts `firePull()`, the `chargeCounter` phase/charge counters); omitting it would fire Wake Up on every FC for 10s after each of her bursts — wrong in principle, though damage-neutral at steady state (the ~7.85s re-trigger cycle < the 10s duration ⇒ ~100% uptime either way; not behaviour-pinnable, see unit-test header). Wake Up uptime is near-permanent after the ~7.85s ramp (first onset on the 6th FC ≈ t=7.9s). S2-L2 'attacking with Full Charge, when in Wake Up status → all allies: True Damage ▲28.16% for 5 sec' = shotFired + swapGate:'swapped' → allies trueDamagePct 28.16 / 5s. shotFired == 'attacking with Full Charge' for an SR (every pull is a full charge; the swap inherits base chargeFrames so swap shots stay charged — helm/liberalio precedent), and shotFired routes through applyBlock so the swapGate (the Wake Up gate) is enforced (chargeCounter would bypass it, vesti-tu finding). allies INCLUDES self (no 'except self' in the kit text) — her own true normals consume this buff. Burst-L3 'when in Wake Up status → all allies: True Damage ▲49.97% for 10 sec' = burstCast + swapGate:'swapped' → allies trueDamagePct 49.97 / 10s; stacks additively with the S2-L2 instance while both are live (distinct buff keys). At steady state every burst cast lands inside the Wake Up window (first cast ≈ t=13-20s, well after the t≈7.9s onset), so the gate is near-damage-neutral there — it matters for casts during the opening ramp or a lapsed window; the unit test pins it swap-keyed via the compound no-Wake-Up counterfactual. BURST-L1 '10 highest-final-DEF enemies: 101.66% of final ATK as damage' = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 101.66, PLAIN flavor (the kit says 'as damage', not 'as true damage' — a true-flavored nuke would dip into her live trueDamagePct stack; the unit test discriminates). The 10-highest-final-DEF targeting collapses to the single boss. Its 'DEF ▼ 9.86% for 10 sec' rider rides the SAME block AFTER the flatDamage (kit-order effects — the cast's own nuke resolves before the fresh shave, novel precedent): defPct -9.86 /10s on the enemy DEF channel, ~0.01% at the scope-lock 140-DEF basis, live at web raid DEF defaults; no stacking clause, and the 20s CD > 10s window means no overlap. B1 cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window → never takes the +50% major (verified helm precedent; pinned in the unit test). trueDamagePct is flavor-gated (sim.ts `dealDamage()`, `opts.trueFlavor`): both team buffs pay ONLY on true-flavored hits — inert on teammates dealing no true damage.
