guillotine.note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02. Guillotine (base) — MG / Attacker / Electric / Burst III, Elysion, slug `guillotine` (the MG/Electric BASE berserker; NOT `guillotine-winter-slayer`, the AR/Water Hero-Level kit). HP-SUBSTRAKE UNIT: her design center is a self HP-drain (S1 'HP ▼2.01%' per 30-NA proc) that opens two HP-threshold gates (S2 'HP<70%' and burst 'HP<50%'). MODEL (cross-family S2b claude-fable-5 converged; driver S0 had under-modeled the HP subsystem as UNMODELED/ungated, the reviewer correctly pushed it onto the engine's resource-counter primitive): the self-drain is a live resource pool 'hpLost' (0..100, +2.01 per 30-NA proc) — the kit's ONLY HP-loss source in the no-boss-damage sim, exactly the soda-twinkling-bunny / phantom / marciana / e-h resource machinery. The two HP gates then read that pool: S2's ATK scaler is a perResource atkPct (hpLost×0.96, live re-read each frame — sim.ts `sum()`, the `perResource` branch 'ignores the static value') behind a resourceGate{hpLost min:30}; the burst's additional hit is a resourceGate{hpLost min:50} flatDamage rider (flatDamage has NO perResource field — laplace-ultimate-hero precedent: gated riders are the faithful encoding of a conditional additional hit). MODEL (6 load-bearing lines): SKILL1 — (S1a) hitCount:30 -> self critRatePct 9.28 /10s ('Activates after landing 30 normal attack(s). Critical Rate ▲9.28% for 10 sec'; GENERIC crit rate — no 'of normal attacks' qualifier, so critRatePct not critRateNormalPct; hitCount +hitsPerShot/shot, MG hitsPerShot 1 -> +1/bullet, refreshes every 30 bullets, 10s window bridges -> near-permanent after the first 30 hits). (S1b) hitCount:30 -> self resource hpLost +2.01 ('HP ▼2.01%' — the self HP COST, modeled as the hpLost counter that feeds the two gates; NOT simulated as an HP pool / damage / heal — inert as HP, load-bearing as the gate enabler; +2.01 additive-of-max per proc, the current-vs-max reading is ambiguous ⚑4). SKILL2 — (S2a) hitCount:150 -> self critDamagePct 14.69 /5s ('after landing 150 normal attack(s). Critical Damage ▲14.69% for 5 sec'; INDEPENDENT counter from S1's 30-hit; 150 hits >> 5s window -> genuinely partial uptime, the buff lapses between procs). (S2b) hitCount:30 + resourceGate{hpLost min:30} -> self atkPct perResource{hpLost, 0.96} /10s ('when HP falls below 70% ... ATK ▲0.96% continuously for every 1% of HP lost'; HP<70% == hpLost>=30; the perResource gives ATK% = hpLost×0.96 live, so +28.8% at the gate, growing as she drains; 'continuously' = live per-frame re-read). TRIGGER NOTE: this is hitCount:30, NOT passive — a passive block fires ONCE at frame 0 (sim.ts's battle-start dispatch, the `passive` trigger) where hpLost=0, so passive+resourceGate{min:30} would lock the buff permanently OFF (the cross-family reviewer itself flagged this risk); the 30-hit re-trigger re-checks the gate every crossing, so the buff switches on at the first crossing after hpLost>=30 (~15th proc) and refreshes every 30 hits thereafter (10s window bridges the ~3s cadence -> continuous once open). BURST — (Ba) burstCast -> enemy flatDamage 1237.5 ('Affects the enemy with the highest final ATK. Deals 1237.5% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage'; highest-final-ATK = the single boss; burstCast resolves pre-FB so no +50% FB major, no range bonus — engine defaults; crit-eligible). (Bb) burstCast + resourceGate{hpLost min:50} -> enemy flatDamage 1237.5 ('Affects the same target when the skill user's HP falls below 50%. Deals 1237.5% of final ATK as additional damage'; HP<50% == hpLost>=50; burstCast re-fires each cast so the gate is re-checked — early casts at hpLost<50 deal ONE nuke, later casts deal TWO; this is faithful gating, NOT the ungated over-credit the driver first shipped). burstCast (her OWN cast), NOT fullBurstEnter — the control fixture carries helm as co-B3, so team FBs != her casts and fullBurstEnter would over-fire. UNMODELED: none — every kit line is represented (the HP drain as the hpLost resource, the two gates via resourceGate, the scaler via perResource). NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑ FLAGS (estimate + recipe + tier): ⚑1 CADENCE TUPLE [mandatory]: MG pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 171 datamine-unverified — drives the hitCount:30/150 crossing cadence, the hpLost accumulation rate, and thus the gate-crossing timing + proc counts. Estimate = datamine as-is. Recipe = rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video. ⚑2 HP-GATE TIMING [low-moderate]: the hpLost pool accrues from SELF-DRAIN ONLY (+2.01/30 hits); real fights also take boss damage, so HP<70% (hpLost 30, ~15 procs/~450 hits) and HP<50% (hpLost 50, ~25 procs/~750 hits) cross EARLIER in reality — the sim delays both gates, slightly UNDER-crediting S2b's ramp and Bb's additional hits early. The gate MAGNITUDES are kit-exact (0.96 mult; 1237.5 rider); only the crossing WALL-CLOCK is ⚑. Recipe = HP-bar crossing times from a focus video. ⚑3 GATE OFF-BY-ONE [low]: S1b (drain +2.01) and S2b (gate min:30) share the hitCount:30 trigger; depending on block-dispatch order the gate may open on the 15th or 16th crossing (hpLost 30.15 vs 28.14 at the check) — a one-proc (~3s) ambiguity, negligible. ⚑4 DRAIN AMBIGUITY [low]: 'HP ▼2.01%' current-vs-max reading unspecified (contrast scarlet's explicit 'Current HP ▼4.01%'); modeled additive-of-max (resource +2.01/proc). Multiplicative-of-current (×0.9799/proc) would slow the accrual (HP<70% at ~18 procs, HP<50% at ~34) — delays the gates a few procs, same direction as ⚑2. Recipe = focus-video HP-bar decay per proc. ⚑5 HEAL INTERACTION [low, S7 judge kimi-code/k3]: hpLost is MONOTONE (no decrement) — engine heals carry no HP amount, so a healing ally (liter) cannot retreat the below-70%/below-50% thresholds; once crossed the gates never close, over-crediting S2b/Bb vs a healed real fight (the boss-damage direction ⚑2 under-credits, this over-credits). No v1 behavioral change possible (nothing to wire). Recipe = focus-video HP-bar refill per heal tick with a healing B1; enact only if an HP-amount heal primitive lands. TIER 2: HP status-gates (resourceGate on S2b + Bb), a live perResource scaler, NA round-counts (hitCount 30/150), meta-defining berserker self-drain. Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5 (converged on the resource-pool model), S5/S6 claude-opus-5, S7 kimi-code/k3 — see scripts/kit-autonomy/results/guillotine.json + manual-review/guillotine.md.

guillotine-winter-slayer.note:
Guillotine: Winter Slayer — AR/Water. Board: 1.024 OK on 1 graded comp. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/guillotine-winter-slayer.test.ts (18 tests). SKIPS: none — every kit line is represented.
HERO LEVEL is a derived currency: EXP +1 per 3 core hits, 10 EXP = +1 Hero Level, cap 11. The core branch dominates at scope-lock core exposure 1.0, so ~30 hits per level puts her at level 11 in ~25s of firing (~28s wall at 60 ammo / 81f reload). It is tracked as a `heroLevel` resource pool (initial 1, max 11), incremented once per hitCount-30 level-up.
THE LEVEL-UP REWARDS ARE CAPPED AT 10 FIRINGS and the cap is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the kit arithmetic self-closes at S2's EXP cap of 100 ÷ 10 EXP per level = 10 level-ups = Level 1 → 11, so there is no 11th reward. Both reward blocks (instantReload 0.1026 and the heal event) carry resourceGate {heroLevel max 10}. Without it the hitCount-30 trigger fires ~56 times over a fight.
S1 auras (PRESERVED, measured-accurate): Water-ally passives at the level-11 steady state — elemAdvantageDamagePct 1.16 x 11 = 12.76 and casterAtkPct 0.91 x 11 = 10.01. The level-up 'Recovers 2.44% of final Max HP' is a heal EVENT block on the same hitCount-30 cadence, self-targeted and event-only: zero self-damage impact, present so recovery-consumer teammates (crown-style) see the proc.
S2: the EXP ATK stack is hitCount 3 x atkPct 1.81, maxStacks 100 (+181% at cap, reached ~32s wall; the engine ramps the stack natively, so no haircut is applied). 'Hero Level 2 or above' → elemAdvantageDamagePct 7.46 as a passive, since level 2 arrives ~3s in and the first-3s over-credit is negligible.
BURST (PRESERVED, measured-accurate): Water-ally attackDamagePct 10.14 + elemAdvantageDamagePct 18.75 (10s), and a 229.57%/s dot for 10s on the boss (= 20.87 x 11, the level-11 snapshot).
Her burst damage is a `dot` AND its kit clause carries a qualifying burst-amp literal, which makes her STRUCTURALLY amp-ineligible however she is tagged — burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only. That is an engine gap, not a tagging decision. There is nothing to tag here; do not try.
CADENCE: pullsPerSec 12 (datamined rate_of_fire 720) + reloadFrames 81, and both STAND — OWNER RULING 2026-08-11: she uses her datamined fire rate; do not refit it. On her graded comp she fires 1813 shots / 180s (~10.1/s realised after reloads) and reads 1.023.
⚑1 EXP BUILD BLEND: shipped at 3 hits/stack, i.e. 100% core, and the level-up trigger at 30 hits inherits that assumption. The realised core-hit fraction is exposure x ACR, and ACR < 1 for an AR without hit-rate support, so non-core hits DO occur and the true cadence is slower: at real core fraction c the effective rate is 1 / (c/3 + (1-c)/6), somewhere in [3, 6]. BLAST RADIUS MEASURED (A/B on PH water B3s, 2026-08-11): re-cadencing to c=0.44 (hitCount 3 -> 4, level-up 30 -> 42) moves her 280M -> 276M, ratio 1.023 -> 1.006 — worth ~1.4% of her damage, not a headline error. Recipe if it is ever worth pinning: focus video, count hits between level-up procs (30 hits/level is the pure-core branch).

k.note: K (`k`) — SMG / Attacker / Electric / Burst III (40s); ammo 120, reloadFrames 129, hitsPerShot 2, normalMult 9.1, coreMult 200, base crit 15%/critDmg 150%. A stack-and-dump burst DPS: she builds 'Tilted Scale' crit rate while firing her SMG, then her burst swaps to a slow 10-pellet electric shotgun for 10s. MODEL — BURST (dominant damage): self weaponSwap (damagePct 92.5, pelletCount 10, weapon 'SG', pullsPerSec 2.4, durationSec 10) + self ATK 63.36% of caster (casterAtkPct) for 10s + self Attack Damage 21.12% for 10s, all on burstCast. The kit's burst weapon is 'Damage 92.5% of final ATK, Pelletcount 10, Attack speed ▼90%, 10s'. The swap is a REAL shotgun: `weapon: 'SG'` routes her burst shots through the same SG accuracy-circle pellet-landing model and the same near-band-only range eligibility as any other SG-class weapon, and `pelletCount: 10` is that weapon's own pellet base for the landing/gauge path. `damagePct: 92.5` is the FULL-SHOT total with all 10 pellets landing — the same convention every SG-class unit's `normalAttackMultiplier` uses in this engine (each pellet carries 92.5/10 = 9.25% of final ATK), so the per-shot damage is 92.5% × (landed pellets / 10). CADENCE: the swap weapon's own nominal fire rate is 144 RPM — 10% of her base SMG's datamined `rate_of_fire` (1440 RPM), matching the kit's 'Attack speed ▼90%' applied to the RAW rate rather than to the already-frame-quantized 20.0/s effective SMG rate. Run through the engine's own frame-quantization formula (`quantizeToFrames`, src/engine/sim.ts `quantizeToFrames()`, FPS/ceil(FPS/nominal)) that every weapon's nominal→effective cadence uses: 144 RPM = 2.4 pulls/s nominal, and 60/2.4 = 25 is already an exact frame count, so quantization is a no-op here (unlike the base SMG's own 1440 RPM, whose 60/24=2.5-frame nominal interval needs the ceiling rule to reach 20.0/s) — pullsPerSec 2.4 is therefore the clean quantized value, not a fitted one. Over 10s = 24 pulls × 92.5% × landing fraction of final ATK before crit/buffs. SKILL1 (Tilted Scale → burst-window crit): self Critical Rate 75% for 10s on burstCast. The literal kit is a STACK RAMP — 'on firing the last bullet: Tilted Scale Critical Rate ▲0.75% continuously, stacks up to 100 times; Tilted Scale stacks ▲29' (i.e. +29 stacks = +21.75% crit per last-bullet fire, capping at 100 stacks = +75%), 'removed when Full Burst ends'. The engine has NO '+N stacks per trigger' primitive (buff apply is +1 stack/trigger, src/engine/sim.ts `applyBuff()`) and NO Full-Burst-end buff-REMOVAL primitive, so the literal sawtooth (build over ~4 last-bullet fires ≈ 33s, wipe at FB end, rebuild) cannot be encoded. The LOAD-BEARING observable is K's crit rate DURING her burst window (the dominant damage source): at steady state she reaches the 100-stack cap (=75%) well before each burst cast (4 last-bullet fires × ~8.15s magazine cycle ≈ 33s < 40s CD), so 'burstCast self critRatePct 75% for 10s' is the faithful steady-state burst-window magnitude. The pre-burst-phase crit (on her modest 9.1%/pull SMG output) and the first-burst ramp (first cast lands before the cap) are under-credited — documented ⚑ below. SKILL2 (Fulfillment of Righteousness): all allies maxAmmoPct ▼51.13% + Attack Damage ▲10.62% for 10s, triggered on lastBullet. The kit trigger is 'when gaining Tilted Scale'; Tilted Scale is ONLY gained on firing the last bullet (skill1), so lastBullet is an EXACT proxy for the trigger (not an approximation). The 10s duration from a ~8.15s-cadence last-bullet fire gives near-continuous team uptime, matching the kit (the buff persists until FB end and is immediately re-applied on the next last bullet). 'Similar effects cannot be stacked' is satisfied by the engine's same-caster buff refresh/overwrite semantics. UNMODELED (honest residuals): (S1c) 'when pellets land a critical hit 4 times → 23.9% of final ATK as additional damage to the target' — the engine has NO crit-GATED hit counter at all (hitCount fires every N cumulative HITS, not every N CRITS; src/skills/types.ts TriggerDef), so a hitCount:4 proxy would count non-crits and fire on the wrong condition. Magnitude is secondary (~5% of burst-window damage at steady-state crit rate). (S1d/S2c) 'when Full Burst ends: removes Tilted Scale / removes Fulfillment of Righteousness' — no FB-end buff-removal primitive; moot for S2 (10s duration self-expires ≈ the FB window) and folded into the burstCast-10s Tilted Scale encoding for S1. kurumi.note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02: test-first faithfulness model authored from blablalink prose (data/characters.json → characters.kurumi.skills). Kurumi (AR/Supporter/Iron, Burst I, cd 20s) is a Hacked-DoT applier + team damage-taken debuffer. S1 'Malicious Code Injection' has TWO triggers, both inflicting the same Hacked DoT (52.24% of final ATK as sustained damage every 1s for 5s = 5 ticks): (A) after landing 36 normal attacks on the target (hitCount:36), and (B) on burst cast to all enemies (burstCast — NOT fullBurstEnter: kurumi is Burst I, so this keys to rotations SHE wins the B1 slot; a fullBurstEnter model would over-credit on rotations a different B1 casts). Each application opens a 5s 'Hacked' status window (targetStatus) AND spawns an independent 5-tick sustained DoT instance (the DoT ticks are crit-eligible at the caster rate per the engine DOT_CRIT default; the kit does not exempt them). S2 'Payload Diffusion' is an 86.17%-of-final-ATK additional-damage rider (flatDamage, crit-eligible by the rider convention, never cores) gated THREE ways: a 36-normal-attack counter (hitCount:36, its own counter independent of S1's), the Full Burst window (fbGate inFb — 'during Full Burst'), and the Hacked status (requiresTargetStatus 'Hacked'). Block order is load-bearing: S1-A precedes S2 in the block array, so on a 36th hit that lands in FB the Hacked status is written earlier the same frame and S2 reads it open (the d-killer-wife same-frame pattern). Burst 'Defense Protocol Breakdown' is a pure debuff — Damage Taken ▲18.06% on all enemies for 10s (damageTakenPct on the enemy → the engine's taken multiplier amplifies ALL damage dealt to the boss while active; the buffApply emits casterIdx/targetIdx null, filter by stat+value); it deals NO damage. The 'all enemies' scope collapses to the single boss entity (targetStatus/damageTakenPct are implicitly enemy-targeted; the validator requires target enemy). Cross-family S2b (claude-fable-5) converged: all four lines FAITHFUL + load-bearing. Residual ⚑s (measurement-gated, engine-native defaults shipped, none block GO): (1) S2's exact proc COUNT is timing-sensitive (a 36-hit multiple must land inside a FB window while Hacked is up) and is not footage-pinned — the magnitude (86.17), the FB-gating, and the status-gate encoding are faithful to prose; the requiresTargetStatus gate is behaviorally near-redundant with the burstCast-Hacked coverage during FB in the control fixture (Hacked is up almost every FB), so its discrimination is masked there — a fixture/measurement limitation, not an encoding gap. (2) DoT re-application STACKING: S1-A re-fires every 36 rounds (~3s of AR fire) with a 5s duration, so the engine appends OVERLAPPING independent DoT instances; whether in-game Hacked REFRESHES (one live instance) or STACKS (multiplying) is kit-silent — the engine-native independent-instance reading is shipped; pin from footage when a Hacked popup-read is available. (3) S2's 36-hit counter is countScope:'gated' (2026-08-16 triage): the kit reads 'during Full Burst after landing 36 normal attack(s)', scoping the COUNTING to FB — the counter accrues only while ALL block gates pass (fbGate inFb AND requiresTargetStatus Hacked), per the engine's blockGatesPass-at-accrual contract. Partial counts carry across FB windows (no per-window reset).

S1 block A ('Activates when entering Full Burst', all allies) = escalating team burstCdr steps [2.34, 2.7, 3.17]s — trigger is fullBurstEnter per the literal text (hard rule 6; fires on EVERY team FB regardless of who bursted), and the engine's escalating case (sim.ts `applyEffect()`, the `escalating` case) applies steps 1..min(N,3) on the Nth activation, so from the 3rd FB on every FB-enter grants the full 2.34+2.7+3.17=8.21s CDR, exactly matching 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'. S1 block B ('Activates when using Burst Skill', all allies) = burstCast (literal text — fires ONLY on rotations LITER bursts, never on another B1's) with escalating buff steps [maxAmmoPct 45.17% / critDamagePct 12.46% / atkPct 14.42%], each 5s; ramps to all three by her 3rd burst cast. maxAmmoPct is a WEAPON-STATE modifier (hard rule 1 / prior 9 — team ammo ▲ = more shots before reload on every teammate), NOT skippable as defensive. The two 'Effects vary according to the number of times…' header lines are IMPLEMENTED by the `escalating` kind. The escalating ladder is cumulative-with-cap — Once v01 → Twice v01+v02 → 3rd+ v01+v02+v03, capping at min(N,3) — matching 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it', so from the 3rd Full Burst on she grants the full 8.21s to every ally. PINNED END-TO-END by scripts/tests/units/liter.test.ts (L1): the one cooldown-bound interval in the fight gives the tier-1 value as exact arithmetic (baseCD − 2.34s), and three counterfactual ladders (no CDR / flat 2.34 / flat 3.17 non-cumulative / flat 8.21 saturated) bracket the shipped behaviour on Full Burst count and total burst casts. Burst = team ATK ▲ 66% for 5s on burstCast. The 5s durations on a ~20s B1 cycle → low buff uptime is KIT-FAITHFUL (Liter's known short-buff character); do not extend without measurement. S2 ('Affects 2 ally unit(s) with the lowest remaining cover HP. Restores 52.5% of Cover HP.') is a NO-OP in the sim [OWNER RULING 2026-07-21]: skill2's icon is `icn_skill_healcover_01` and the text restores COVER HP, NOT a unit's HP. It does NOT emit a unit-RECOVERY event, so it must NOT trigger recovery-consumer teammates. Modeling it as a `heal`→allies on fullBurstEnter was SPURIOUSLY firing Crown's S2 ('when recovery takes effect' → all allies Attack Damage ▲ 20.99%) every Full Burst, inflating the WHOLE team's damage (the uniform ~1.3 HOT on the Liter/Crown/Chisato/Helm 720-kit-audit comp — liter 1.36 / crown 1.16 / chisato 1.30 / helm 1.27, on scope-lock). caveats: skill1: the Sea Breeze DEF-reduction EFFECT is unmodeled — there is no dynamic enemy-DEF-reduction primitive (cfg.bossDef is a fixed per-hit subtraction; damageTakenPct is a separate bucket). skill1: Sea Breeze is modeled as a passive always-present targetStatus (frame 0, 999s) — the kit's 'after 2 normal crits, up to 50 stacks, 3s refresh' accrual/decay is folded into a steady-state always-afflicted assumption (⚑; there is no crit-count trigger to drive discrete accrual). In a sustained fight the boss is afflicted for essentially the whole fight after the ~12s ramp, so Storm's requiresTargetStatus gate is always satisfied (structurally faithful — it WOULD block Storm if Sea Breeze were down — but never blocks in steady state).

skill1: 'Activates when HP falls below 70% -> Critical Damage ▲50.94% continuously' is modeled as a passive always-on grant (no durationSec — 'continuously' = no expiry). v1 has no HP pool, so the gate cannot be literally evaluated; a squishy Supporter sits below 70% HP for essentially the whole sustained fight from boss damage WHETHER OR NOT she bursts, so the grant is assumed up for the whole fight (the pre-first-burst transient of a few seconds above 70% is neglected). CROSS-FAMILY: the S5 blind test writer (claude-opus-5) independently derived this passive/always-on encoding. The S2b reviewer (claude-fable-5) proposed a burstCast SELF-TRIGGER — the burst's un-restoring Max-HP grant (Max HP ▲86.2%, current HP unchanged) drops her HP ratio to 1/1.862 ≈ 53.7% < 70% for the 7s window — which is a real in-sim mechanism; it was REJECTED as primary because it makes the grant comp-dependent (zero uptime in any comp where mast does not burst, contradicting the real game where boss damage keeps her below 70% regardless). ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED: the real uptime, and whether the buff latches permanently vs condition-held, settle on a Mast-focus recording; the burstCast-7s window is the literal in-sim reading, passive-always-on is the real-game-faithful reading (this encoding).

burst: Storm is modeled at the 50-stack CAP mirror (4.52% x 50 = 226%/tick, 7 ticks/burst) — the steady-state stack count (⚑ near-cap; the ~12s opening ramp where stacks accrue 0->50 is folded into the 180s average). Refine the stack count on a Mast-focus recording if the sim reads hot/cold. The DoT crits at Mast's sheet rate (DOT_CRIT default ON, U13 2026-07-21 — DoT/function damage crits in NIKKE, confirmed ginmy/maiden footage; the kit need not say so explicitly) and never cores (DoTs are core-ineligible). It is unflavored (plain damage — not sustained/distributed/sequential), so it rides the normal Damage-Up bucket. ENCODING CHOICE: a FIXED steady-state DoT (the mihara-bonding-chain precedent — mihara's Ensnaring/Dragons DoTs are fixed atkPct, NOT perResource). The S2b reviewer proposed a LIVE perResource seaBreeze pool read per tick; that is theoretically sharper (an early burst would mirror fewer stacks) but is NOT faithfully drivable here: the pool would accrue on a 2-normal-CRIT trigger, and the engine's hitCount counts ROUNDS not crits (no crit-count primitive), so any accrual threshold is a crit-rate-dependent ⚑ estimate. The fixed cap-mirror trades that unmodeled ramp for a single documented ⚑ (near-cap steady state), consistent with mihara; the first-burst over-credit is ~1/10 of Storm damage and partially bounded (stacks reach near-cap within the ~12s ramp). STACK-COUNT ⚑ (cross-family): the 50 cap assumes the 3s window REFRESHES on each application (shared timer — applications land every ~0.2s at the SMG fire rate × buffed crit rate, far faster than the 3s expiry, so stacks pile to the cap and bind there; 'stacks up to 50' implies the cap is reachable in normal play, and stack-building is Mast's design identity). The S5 blind writer (claude-opus-5) read 'lasts for 3 sec' as a PER-STACK expiry (each stack dies 3s after it lands), giving a turnover steady state of critRate×fireRate/2×3s ≈ 14 stacks where the cap never binds (Storm ≈ 63%/tick). The two differ ~3.6×; the shared-refresh/cap-bind reading is encoded here as the more standard NIKKE stacking-debuff behaviour, but the magnitude is measurement-gated — a Mast-focus popup read of a Storm tick settles stacks = tick% / 4.52%.

burst: 'Max HP ▲86.2% of the skill user's Max HP without restoring HP' is casterMaxHpPct, offensively inert in v1 (no HP pool; ally-granted Max HP does not feed atkOfMaxHpPct per the e3 rule, and Mast has no self HP-scaling ATK). Encoded for kit completeness; it moves no damage.

Mast: Romantic Maid — MG/Water. Board: 0.951 COLD on 2 graded comps (0.89 / 1.01). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mast-romantic-maid.test.ts (20 assertions). Four approximations in this file are owner-ruled or data-validated rather than kit-literal — all four are listed in caveats.
THE DRUNKEN CYCLE is modeled dynamically: +1 stack per Burst-1 stage entry, capped at 3; on every 3rd of HER OWN burst casts the stacks reset and Hangover STUNS her for 10s (an everyN:3 gate plus a stun effect), during which she cannot fire, charge or reload. The gate is on her own casts, not on Full-Burst ends: a never-bursting mast is never stunned, which is the kit's meaning of 'her own Drunken' and is what the real samples show.
x-STACKS VALUES USE THE CYCLE AVERAGE OF 2, not the cap of 3 — stacks run 1, 2, 3 and then reset, so 2 is the time-weighted mean. S2 stage-3 buffs ship 15.03 x 2 = 30.06% Distributed Damage and 15.04 x 2 = 30.08% Reload Speed for 10s; the burst's ATK-of-caster ships 20.06 x 2 = 40.12%. This is an average bake, NOT a bake-at-cap, and it is deliberate.

mica-snow-buddy.note: Mica: Snow Buddy (slug `mica-snow-buddy`, aka msb): Tetra IRON SMG SUPPORTER, Burst I, 20s burst CD, 120-ammo SMG (1440 rpm), reloadFrames 141. A variant of the RL/Wind base Mica. A team ATK buffer + burst-gauge enabler whose DPS channels are (1) the burst team ATK buff, (2) a self burst-gauge-fill-speed buff, and (3) a max-ammo team buff gated behind her Tidying-Up stack clock. --- LINE DISPOSITIONS --- BURST 'ATK ▲39.93% of the skill user's ATK for 5 sec, all allies': modeled `casterAtkPct` 39.93 on `burstCast` → allies (INCLUDES self — 'Affects all allies', no except-self), 5s. Caster-basis FLAT add ((39.93/100)×her static ATK), NOT % of each ally's own ATK. Her dominant DPS contribution. BURST 'Removes 1 debuff(s), all allies': UNMODELED — defensive/utility debuff cleanse; the v1 boss applies no debuffs, so there is nothing to remove and no DPS channel (carried verbatim in unmodeled.burst). S2 'start of battle, self: Burst Gauge filling speed ▲300% continuously': modeled `burstGenPct` 300, passive self (frame 0, no expiry) — scales her OWN burst-gauge contribution ×4; 'continuously' = permanent. S2 'on landing 150 normal attacks, all allies: Stack count of buffs ▲1': PARTIALLY MODELED. 'Stack count of buffs ▲1' adds a stack to active stackable buffs on all allies; her OWN Tidying-Up is such a buff, so the SELF-directed portion is modeled as a +1 to the `tidyingUp` resource pool on hitCount:150 (Block C), which accelerates the max-ammo gate (measured effect: pulls activation from ~78.6s to ~46.6s in the fixture). The CROSS-ALLY portion (adding stacks to TEAMMATES' own stackable buffs) is out-of-domain — the engine has no generic per-buff stack-count primitive that reaches into other units' buff stacks — and is documented (⚑ M5). S1 'on landing 120 normal attacks, all allies: Tidying Up Damage Taken ▼2%, stacks 10x, 15s': PARTIALLY MODELED. The STACK CLOCK is modeled — a `tidyingUp` resource pool (0..10) incremented on hitCount:120 (Block A) — because it is the GATE for the max-ammo line. The defensive '2% Damage Taken ▼' MAGNITUDE is NOT modeled: it is a damage-taken REDUCTION on allies, and the sim models no incoming damage (immortal boss), so the value moves zero damage (⚑ M3). CRITICAL: this is NOT encoded as the boss-debuff stat `damageTakenPct` (the schema's only damage-taken stat is a boss debuff = boss takes MORE); the kit line is ▼ on ALLIES (defensive), the inverse channel — encoding it on the boss would wrongly add up to +20% team damage. S1 'when Tidying Up is at max stacks, all allies: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲40% continuously': modeled `maxAmmoPct` 40 → allies, gated on `resourceGate {tidyingUp, min:10}` and re-asserted on each hitCount:120 once the gate passes (permanent — 'continuously'). The mechanic is in-domain; the ACTIVATION is the stack gate, which the resource pool encodes. --- STACK-SEMANTICS ASSUMPTION (drives M4 activation): the pool is monotonic (0→10, clamped, no decay) = 'once 10 stacks accrue, the ammo buff is permanent'. This commits to the REFRESH-ON-REAPPLY reading of 'Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 15 sec' (each stack application refreshes the whole buffer to 15s, so stacks build monotonically to 10 since applications arrive ~every 7-8s, faster than the 15s expiry). The alternative per-stack-independent-decay reading would cap concurrent stacks at ~2 and the gate would NEVER open (0% uptime); refresh-on-reapply is the standard NIKKE convention for stackable timed buffs, so the driver adopts it and documents the alternative (⚑ M4). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mihara-bonding-chain.test.ts (13 tests, groups M1-M5).
RESTRAINT CHAINS: charged to 10 at battle start and refilled to 10 at each Full-Burst end after her own burst; the S1 'specific timing' attack then dumps all of them, one 50.06% hit per chain. Modeled as a 500.6% (10 x 50.06) flatDamage dump on a passive at battle start and again on fullBurstEnd — she is the team's Burst III, so Full-Burst end coincides with her burst end.
ENSNARING CHAINS: a sustained-damage DoT capped at 20 stacks, fed by the Restraint hits and by S2's +1 per 40 normals during Full Burst. Her burst CANCELS Ensnaring to 0; it rebuilds +10 from the Restraint dump at the following FB end and +1 per 40 normals during FB windows, reaching the 20 cap before her next burst. Shipped as a LIVE pool: `resources.ensnaring` [0..20], a permanent DoT carrying `perResource {ensnaring, 25.08}` so each tick's magnitude is the CURRENT stack count x 25.08, +10 resource blocks on the two Restraint dumps, +1 on a `hitCount:40` block gated to Full Burst, and a -20 on her burst that clamps the pool to zero. There is no fitted stack number left in this file — the stack trajectory emerges from the kit's own generation and spend.
BURST — Dragging Chain mirrors the 20 Ensnaring stacks for 10s, i.e. the full 1001%/s (20 x 50.05), and cancels Ensnaring. With a live pool the no-double-count property is STRUCTURAL rather than arithmetic: the cancel zeroes the pool, the baseline DoT reads that zero and stops contributing on its own, so the window sums to exactly 1001%/s. The superseded model could not switch a static baseline off, so it shipped a 700 DELTA (1001 - 301) to subtract it — a decomposition that only held while the baseline was a constant. Removing the cancel is now the double-count counterfactual, and the spec pins it.
DoTs correctly inherit S2's stageEnter-3 sustainedDamagePct +59.98% / 10s through the Damage-Up bucket.
Her burst damage is a dot, and its kit clause is NOT one of the burst-amp literals, so the 'burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only' engine gap is MOOT for her — there is nothing to tag and no eligibility claim to make.
NOT MODELED, by disposition: S2's 'when the skill user is incapacitated → Ensnaring +20' (defensive; the boss deals no damage) and 'when an enemy is neutralized → Restraint +1' (the boss never dies). S2's 40-normals-in-Full-Burst Ensnaring generation is a discrete hitCount:40 fbGate:'inFb' block feeding the live pool.

milk-blooming-bunny.note: EMBARRASSMENT IS UNMODELED (owner ruling 2026-08-12), and she carries NO mode split. The state procs only when a Full Charge is HELD an extra 0.5s (Prydwen) — a manual action the auto-play the sim models never performs — and the held-charge cycle is not faithfully representable here, so the second 'manual (Embarrassment cycle)' mode that approximated it was REMOVED rather than shipped as a selectable model nothing had validated. She is one model: a plain SR (no 118.7% ATK, no 290% procs, a normal magazine) plus her burst buffs and the S2 burst DoT. All five Embarrassment effects are filed verbatim in `unmodeled.skill1`, and the S2 Pierce-Damage line they gate in `unmodeled.skill2`. Board-inert on landing: the mode gate had already filtered these blocks out of the default auto basis, so removing them is byte-identical (pinned by MBB5). ORIGINAL NOTE: Embarrassment is modeled as her permanent operating mode (it re-triggers on every full-charge shot and dominates the fight). Each full charge that isn't already in Embarrassment fires one charged normal, then deals 290% Distributed Damage, dumps her ammo, and force-reloads at -50% reload speed -- i.e. one charged shot per reload cycle. Modeled by: passive maxAmmoPct -100 (floors magazine to 1 -> one shot then reload) + reloadSpeedClamp -50 (the fixed slow reload) + a permanent ATK +118.7% (Effect 5, refreshed every cycle so effectively always on), and a fullCharge 290% distributed hit (fires ~once per cycle because ammo is 1). S2's Overconfident (burst) line -- 447.7% Distributed every 2s for 10s -- is modeled as a burstCast DoT (interval 2s, duration 10s = 5 ticks); parser had dropped it under an unsupported trigger. Burst's ATK +220%/10s is left to the parser (correct); its Pierce buffs and S1/S2 Pierce buffs are inert (pierceDamagePct is v1-inert), and 'Gain Pierce' is likewise inert. KEY UNCERTAINTIES / approximations, flagged: (1) The burst's 'Immunity to Embarrassment for 10s' is NOT modeled -- during the 10s burst she should revert to a full 6-round magazine + normal reload (many more charged normals) with no 290% procs; instead she keeps the 1-shot slow-reload cadence, so her burst-window normal damage is UNDER-counted while ~1-2 stray 290% procs are OVER-counted (partial offset). Modeling the immunity via a counter-buff was rejected because it would instead re-proc 290% on every burst normal shot (a larger over-count). (2) The first magazine fires all 6 starting rounds before the -100 max-ammo cap applies on reload, a minor early-fight over-count of normals + 290% procs. (3) The S2 DoT loses the 'distributed' flavor (dot has no flavor field), but distributed damage vs a single boss deals full value and she carries no distributedDamagePct, so no boost is lost. mint.note:
Mint — RL/Iron. Board: 1.015 OK on 1 graded comp (PA MiKa), which pairs her with prika and therefore runs mode 'duet (w/ Prika)'. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mint.test.ts, green vs shipped and red vs every named counterfactual (full-uptime S1, full-value S2, halved-burst, reversed parity, toggle-removed).
THE ASSIGNED-PART TOGGLE. Each of Mint's OWN burst casts flips her Assigned Part between Dancing and Singing — Dancing on cast 1, then Singing, Dancing, Singing, in strict alternation (owner-confirmed parity). It is modeled with a `singing` resource (0 = Dancing, 1 = Singing, declared in `resources`, initial 0) driven by two mode:'solo' blocks on her own burstCast: everyN 2 / everyNOffset 1 → delta −1 on her odd casts, everyN 2 / everyNOffset 0 → delta +1 on her even casts. Her Singing-gated lines then carry resourceGate {singing min 1} at FULL kit-literal magnitude and are live only on Singing rotations — S1 Singing Effect casterAtkPct 45.02, and S2 (enter Burst Stage 3 while Singing) critRatePct 19.94 / projectileExplosionPct 50 / pierceDamagePct 32.72. Full value on alternate rotations, NOT half value on every rotation; those differ whenever teammate damage is not spread evenly across her windows.
THE BURST'S SING ALONG BUFFS ARE UNCONDITIONAL — attackDamagePct 30.02, maxAmmoPct 40, critDamagePct 45.05, 10s, every rotation in every mode. They are deliberately outside the toggle; the kit does not gate them on an Assigned Part.
DANCING is a heal and nothing else: an event-only heal (ticks 3, intervalSec 1) per full-charge pull, resourceGate {singing max 0}, solo mode. There is no HP pool, so it moves damage ONLY through a Crown-style on-recovery consumer; in a consumer-less comp a Dancing rotation still contributes nothing. The HP magnitude (1.8% of her final Max HP) has no engine consumer and is recorded as unmodeled.
MODES. 'solo' is the graded DEFAULT (owner ruling) and matches her un-augmented kit behaviour. 'duet (w/ Prika)' exists because prika's S2 enforces a permanent Singing state, so that mode drops the gate and runs the Singing values unconditionally. A team pairing her with prika must SELECT the duet mode explicitly.
⚠ DUET ROTATION: in graded comps holding BOTH mint and prika, prika takes the FIRST burst and MINT TAKES EVERY BURST AFTER — driven from prika's side by her duet-mode burstFirst + burstCdr −9999. It requires the comp to select the duet modes on BOTH units. A harness that does not runs them solo and reports mint artificially COLD. If she ever reads far colder in one tool than another, CHECK MODE SELECTION FIRST.
⚑ OPEN (1) TEAMMATE-DAMAGE COVARIANCE: the alternating gate assumes teammates' damage is spread evenly across her Singing and Dancing windows. If it clusters toward or away from Singing (reload or cooldown alignment), the true board value differs. Solo mode currently has ZERO real-fight anchor — her only graded comp forces duet — so this is unanchored, not merely unmeasured. Estimate a few % at board level in a future solo-mint comp; recipe: a Mint-focus solo recording comparing Singing-window against Dancing-window team damage; tier 2.
FULL-CHARGE TRIGGER: 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge' is encoded on the fullCharge primitive (fires only on charged pulls); in-sim an RL (chargeFrames 60) releases exclusively at full charge, so the cadence is every pull — the always-full-charge fire model is an engine-wide premise (pinned by the trigger-kinds matrix), no longer a unit-local proxy. Every blind re-derivation shared that premise, so their agreement is convergent rather than independent evidence. No encoding change unless the engine's RL path can emit an uncharged or partial shot — verify that, and if it can, gate on the charged-shot event; tier 3.
NOT ENCODED, deliberately: S2's 'Cancels Assigned Part' block. This is an expressibility GAP — resourceGate reads a resource POOL, not a buff-active/absent state, so 'while NOT in Sing Along status' has no primitive. Omitting it is the safe direction: when Mint casts every rotation (20s cooldown) her Sing Along is live at every stage-3 entry and the cancel would never fire anyway, whereas encoding it unconditionally would strip her parts every rotation. The burst's 'gains Assigned Part' lines are the toggle's own bookkeeping, already expressed by the `singing` resource.

nihilister.note: Nihilister (slug nihilister) — SR / Attacker / Fire / Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 6, chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, normalMult 69.04, coreMult 200. FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-08-04 (no prior override; simSupported:false before this pass). A piercing-fire boss-warfare Attacker: full-charge shots grant her a 1-round Pierce tag, her S2 nukes on an internal CD, and her burst deals instant damage + a 10s Burn + a 15s self ammo-capacity extension. SKILL1 ('Burning Shot', passive) — L1 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge. Affects self. Gain Pierce for 1 round(s)' = shotFired → self gainPierce durationShots 1. SR auto-full-charges every shot (milk-blooming-bunny precedent), so shotFired IS the full-charge trigger, and 'for 1 round(s)' is encoded LITERALLY as a round budget: the tag is spent by FIRING, never by the clock, so no reload or lull can drain it — the next round she fires is the round the kit promised. She previously shipped a durationSec 4 wall-clock stand-in derived as the longest inter-shot gap she fires across (~3.7s worst case). Her steady cycle does max out at 3.87s, but her control fixture holds ONE 4.50s lull, so the stand-in silently dropped a shot's tag every fight (measured 2026-08-11: ~87k of her 61.5M normal-bucket damage). The fix was the primitive, not a bigger number — scripts/tests/engine/gain-pierce-rounds.test.ts pins the round-count form, and her N1 pin re-derives that lull on every run so the assertion keeps discriminating rounds from seconds. The grant lands AFTER the triggering shot's damage (shotFired dispatch order — the phantom ⚑2 engine-order class): shot 1 is the application event, every shot from the 2nd on is tagged while firing. NOT a static hasPierce:true flag (the nearest-wrong form: tags from frame 0, survives downtime, no trigger). The tag is damage-relevant ONLY via ally Pierce Damage ▲ buffs (d-killer-wife's 13.55 to SR allies) — she carries no pierceDamagePct source herself; load-bearing through that feed, modeled for kit completeness + team synergy per the alice/prika/naga Pierce-tag convention. L2 'Piercing Radius ▲ 50% for 1 round(s)' = UNMODELED verbatim — GEOMETRY, not Pierce Damage (the nearest-wrong misread is a pierceDamagePct +50 buff); v1 has no spatial/hitbox model (single partless boss), so a radius increase has no consumer; couples to L3 (⚑3/⚑4, out-of-domain). L3 'Activates when hits 2 or more enemies concurrently → all enemies hit: 50.33% of final ATK as additional damage' = UNMODELED verbatim — v1 fields exactly ONE enemy, so the condition is structurally unsatisfiable; an ungated flatDamage 50.33 rider would be the single most damaging misread in this kit (~+73% of her normal line on every shot) and is rejected; the line is a real multi-target lever out-of-domain (⚑3). SKILL2 ('Megiddo Flame') — 'Affects enemies within attack range. Deals 112.64% of final ATK as damage' on the datamined skillCooldownsSec.skill2 = 10s CD = interval:10 → flatDamage 112.64 vs enemy. The prose carries NO activation clause → class-1 pure timer (helm-aquamarine S2a precedent, docs/handoffs/2026-07-20-skill-cooldowns-to-sim.md): first fire t=10, then t=20,… (⚑2 first-fire phase; 17 hits/180s). Crit-eligible (flatDamage default), never cores (no core label), noRange (instant rider default). BURST ('Burning Scourge', all three lines burstCast-keyed — HER casts only, NOT fullBurstEnter: she is one of potentially several B2s and a different B2's Full Burst must not fire these) — L1 'enemies within the attack range: 158.59% of final ATK as damage' = burstCast → flatDamage 158.59 vs enemy; burst-cast damage auto-snapshots pre-FB / is FB-exempt (prior 2; no noFb) and never takes the +50% major. L2 'Burn: 13.19% of final ATK as sustained damage every 1 sec for 10 sec' = burstCast → dot atkPct 13.19 / durationSec 10 / intervalSec 1 / flavor 'sustained' — a REAL DoT: 10 discrete 1s ticks per cast (cd 20s > 10s window → instances never overlap), never cores (DoT rule), ticks crit via the engine's UNIVERSAL DoT-crit gate (DOT_CRIT default-ON, sim.ts U13 — mechanic confirmed ginmy/maiden/little-mermaid footage, Fable-approved), and NO per-dot crit opt-in (the opt-in is reserved for measured per-DoT divergence), flavor feeds any sustainedDamagePct source. L3 'self: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 6 round(s) for 15 sec' = burstCast → self buff maxAmmoFlat 6 / durationSec 15 — the FLAT round primitive (theme 14 '▲ N round(s)'), NOT maxAmmoPct (the % form only coincides at her 6-round base as maxAmmoPct 100 — the trap; maxAmmoPct 6 would be ≈ inert). The cap raises live (increases never clip, sim.ts) and the extended 12-round magazine loads at her next reload inside the window — real damage (fewer reloads → more shots). UNMODELED (2 lines, verbatim, both skill1): the Piercing Radius geometry line and the 2+-enemies-concurrent bonus — see L2/L3 above. NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑1 (cadence tuple, standard): chargeFrames 60 + ~22f bolt gap ≈ 1.37s/shot and reloadFrames 141 are datamine (unverified for this unit); the gainPierce durationSec 4 stand-in derives from them (worst-case inter-shot gap ≈3.7s). Estimate: ±10% cycle → the 4s window still covers (margin to 2×cycle ≈ 2.7s). Recipe: read shot cycle + reload gap from any nihilister-focus video. Tier 1 (standard cadence ⚑). ⚑2 (S2 first-fire phase): t=10 vs t=0 convention (helm-aquamarine class-1) — worth exactly one 112.64% proc over the basis. Recipe: a focused-solo run, time the first 112.64% popup + its interval. Tier 2. ⚑3 (2+-target bonus, OUT-OF-DOMAIN): the 50.33%-of-final-ATK rider on every piercing shot through ≥2 enemies — a BIG hidden lever on multi-target content, dead in v1's single-enemy scope. Estimate: ~+50.33% of final ATK per qualifying shot to each enemy hit. Recipe: needs a multi-target engine model (concurrent-hit detection) + a multi-enemy recording; resurface with ⚑4. Tier: out-of-domain (no primitive, cannot fire or be measured here). ⚑4 (Piercing Radius, OUT-OF-DOMAIN): the +50% pierce-line radius that governs how many enemies a piercing shot covers — geometry v1 does not model; couples to ⚑3. Recipe: resurface if multi-target geometry enters scope. Tier: out-of-domain. TIER 2 overall: interval CD timer, burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter keying, flavor-gated DoT, flat-ammo primitive. Faithful>fit; measured>fudge. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-04.

Burst DEF line ('DEF ▲ 133.48% for 10 sec', all allies) is encoded as defPct — the LITERAL form this time: the kit grants each ally a percentage of their OWN DEF, which is exactly what defPct scales (contrast marciana's burst DEF line, which is caster-DEF-scaled and therefore only a semantic approximation). defPct is deliberately INERT in v1: self DEF never enters damage dealt and there is no incoming damage, so the grant moves no unit's total — kept for kit completeness (marciana's inert-defPct convention) and for any future DEF consumer/scaler.

The 10%-when-attacked activation is also unfireable — the `attacked` trigger exists (types.ts) but the v1 boss attacks nobody, and the schema has no RNG/chance gate.

S2 'Taunt for 2 sec' + 'ATK ▼ 13.25% for 5 sec' UNMODELED: v1 models no aggro/targeting and no enemy stats (the boss deals no damage, so an enemy ATK ▼ has no consumer). NOT encoded as a targetStatus (that channel is for kit-NAMED gateable statuses such as d-killer-wife's Wipe Out; fabricating a 'Taunt' status would invent a gate no kit line asks for — folkwang precedent), NOT as a negative atkPct on self/allies (the ▼ is on THE TARGET — the enemy). The full-charge-hit activation clause is expressible (chargeCounter count:1 — the sim's RL always full-charges), unenacted because both effects (taunt, enemy ATK ▼) are out-of-domain regardless.
Burst 'Attract: Taunt all enemies for 10 sec' UNMODELED: same no-aggro ruling as S2's taunt.

Burst 'Invulnerable for 3 sec' UNMODELED: v1 models no HP pool / death / incoming damage. Invulnerability is a distinct named mechanic from Shield in kit vocabulary (marciana's Storage precedent).

Zero damage lines and zero weapon-state modifiers in the whole kit: noah's entire board footprint is ONE inert defPct channel on her own burst casts. Her personal damage is weapon-only (RL charge, hitsPerShot 2). skill2: ■ Activates when hitting a target with a Full Charge attack. Affects the target. Taunts for 2 sec. — aggro/targeting control; the sim is single-target with a fixed boss script and no taunt/aggro primitive, so hit location never changes damage. ⚑ inert / out-of-domain (see caveats).
burst: Constantly recovers 2.47% of the skill user's final Max HP every 1 sec for 10 sec. — magnitude only: the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool), so the number is unmodeled; the recovery EVENT is modeled (heal, burst slot), which is the board-relevant half — on-recovery consumers read the event, never the amount.

caveats: skill1 (Damage Taken ▼) ⚑ engine-core / out-of-domain, now ENCODED: 'when attacked 20× → all allies Damage Taken ▼10.66% for 20s' ships as an `attacked` block targeting `allies` with damageTakenPct -10.66 (owner ruling 2026-08-13; moran's ally-side -35.14 is the precedent). It is inert TWICE OVER, by mechanism rather than by fixture: the counter never accrues (recordAttack's only caller is the manualAttacks test hook), and the engine sums damageTakenPct off the BOSS's buff list alone, so an ally-targeted one has no consumer roster-wide. Target and SIGN are the load-bearing part — a positive value on `enemy` is the F10 inversion that would manufacture a phantom team-wide damage GAIN, which is why the ally-negative form is the only faithful encoding. ESTIMATE: in a real fight this is a meaningful team survivability buff (≈10.66% less damage taken for 20s once the 20-hit counter accrues), but it scales only damage RECEIVED, which the v1 sim does not model — damage-neutral here. RECIPE: add an engine ally-HP-pool + incoming-boss-damage model and an'allies take ▼X% damage' received-damage stat (distinct from the boss-facing damageTakenPct debuff), then encode S1 on an on-being-attacked hitCount:20 trigger to allies. TIER: engine-core (new primitive), out-of-domain for the no-incoming-damage v1 sim — same precedent as flora's HP-gated S2 and liter's cover-HP NO-OP.

skill2 (Taunt) ⚑ inert / out-of-domain: 'hitting a target with a Full Charge → Taunts for 2s'. ESTIMATE: damage-neutral — taunt redirects enemy aggro, which a single-target sim with a fixed boss script never exercises. RECIPE: none for DPS (would need a multi-target/aggro model). TIER: inert / out-of-domain.

skill2/burst Max-HP grants are encoded for kit-SSOT completeness but are OFFENSIVELY INERT: Noise has no atkOfMaxHpPct conversion, so the S2 self grant (casterIdx===self) feeds no HP-scaling, and the burst team grant lands on allies (casterIdx≠target) which the e3 video rule excludes from feeding a teammate's conversion anyway. Both emit maxHpFlat buffApply events (queryable, future HP-consumer ready) and move no team total — pinned by the strip-diff inertia assertions in noise.test.ts (N1/N3).

burst heal: the HP MAGNITUDE (2.47% of caster final Max HP per tick) is not modeled (no HP pool) — only the per-second recovery EVENT cadence (ticks:10 over 10s) is, which is what recovery-consumer teammates (crown-type) key off. The heal-over-time emits its first recovery event immediately, then 9 more at 1s intervals (≈10 events spanning ~9s per cast).
noise.note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-31 (Tier 2). Noise (`noise`, RL / Supporter / Electric / Burst I, cd 40s, ammo 6, chargeFrames 60, chargeMultiplier 250): a DEFENSIVE healer-buffer whose OWN RL damage is her only damage output and whose EVERY skill line is survivability / team-preservation — Damage-Taken reduction, a taunt, Max-HP grants, and a heal. P3 same block → allies casterAtkPct 20 (20% of PRIKA's ATK, so a flat, identical grant on every ally). P4 Encore → allies attackDamagePct 25.01 / 10s. P5 burst Performance → allies chargeDamagePct 25 / 25s. P6 is the sign that matters: Encore's 'Cooldown of Burst Skill ▲ 21 sec' is an INCREASE — the price of the Performance extension — encoded as burstCdr seconds -21 (positive burstCdr reduces), taking her 40s cooldown to 61s and giving 3 casts per 180s rather than the 9 a decrease misread would give.
MODES are load-bearing, not cosmetic. 'solo' = 25s Performance per burst with Encore proxied per Full Burst entry. 'duet (w/ Mint)' = the owner-confirmed real rotation in comps holding BOTH mint and prika: PRIKA TAKES THE FIRST BURST, THEN MINT TAKES EVERY BURST FOR THE REST OF THE FIGHT. Two mode-gated blocks implement it — a passive burstFirst (she takes burst 1 regardless of slot order, so slot order does not matter) and a burstCast burstCdr -9999 (she then locks out). ⚠ A harness that does NOT select 'duet (w/ Mint)' runs her solo, neither block fires, and she reads artificially COLD. If she ever reads far colder in one tool than another, CHECK MODE SELECTION FIRST — that is the failure this warning exists for.
ENCORE IS A PROXY. The real trigger is 'Sing Along takes effect while Prika is in Performance' — a cross-unit partner mechanic (Mint). Solo mode approximates it as firing once per Full Burst entry, which over-credits the ally Attack Damage ▲25.01% AND over-applies the self burst-cooldown ▲21s in comps with no Sing Along caster. The proxy also splits one game proc across two triggers (Effect 3 on fullBurstEnter, Effect 4 on burstCast), so in any two-B2 comp the benefit outruns the price. ⚑ OPEN, owner's call: mode-gating BOTH Encore effects to duet-only is the faithful alternative — board-moving only if a solo-prika comp is ever graded.
⚑ OPEN — DUET ENCORE WINDOW (narrowed 2026-08-12, not closed): the duet-mode Encore attackDamagePct ships durationSec 9999 against a printed 'for 10 sec'. The premise UNDER it is now owner-CONFIRMED — in duet, Performance stays up the whole fight and never lapses — which settles Effect 2 (Performance duration) and with it the two windows that rest on it, her Pierce tag and her chargeDamagePct. It does NOT settle Effect 3, whose own 10s window is a separate clause. The tag and the chargeDamagePct therefore stand or fall TOGETHER — if that premise is ever refuted, move BOTH windows, never one. privaty-unkind-maid.note: privaty-unkind-maid (Privaty: Unkind Maid, aka pum) — Electric SG Attacker, Burst III (cd 40s), ammo 9 / reloadFrames 141 / hitsPerShot 10 pellets / normalMult 182.1. A pellet-counter kit; ALL FIVE load-bearing lines modeled. SKILL1 'Activates when hitting the target with 30 pellets → 2 enemies nearest crosshair → 202.84% final ATK' = hitCount count:30 → enemy → flatDamage 202.84 noRange. The engine hit counter adds hitsPerShot (=10) per trigger PULL (sim.ts `firePull()`, the `hitCounters` increment), so '30 pellets' = every 3rd pull, firing REPEATEDLY (cumulative). The counter counts FIRED pellets (10/pull regardless of landing); the kit reads 'hitting with 30 pellets' = LANDED — at single-boss focus-band landing ~9/10 the two are near-equivalent (⚑1, banded cadence). The '2 enemies nearest the crosshair' collapses to the lone boss on the partless single-boss basis (caveat). Rider conventions: crit-on at sheet rate (engine flatDamage default), NO core (no 'core strike' text), noRange (skill riders never take the +30% range major), FB-by-timing (noFb NOT set). SKILL2 line 1 '≥5 pellets hit with a single normal attack → self → Reload Speed ▲20.88% for 2s' = shotFired → self → reloadSpeedPct 20.88 / 2s. The per-shot '≥5 pellets' landing gate has NO engine primitive and is DROPPED — assumed satisfied: a single boss at the focus band lands ~9/10 pellets, well over 5, and the 2s window refreshed every ~0.67s shot gives ~100% uptime regardless, so the gate is not load-bearing (⚑2). Reload Speed IS damage-bearing (reloadFrames 141 on a 9-shell mag gates shots fired) — NOT a defensive skip. SKILL2 line 2 '30 pellet hits during Full Burst → self → Reload 1 round + ATK ▲11.22% ×5 / 2s' = hitCount count:30 + fbGate:'inFb' → self → instantReload fraction 0.1111 (≈1/9 = ONE shell of the 9-shell mag, NOT a full refill) + buff atkPct 11.22 maxStacks 5 / 2s. fbGate:'inFb' (sim.ts `blockGatesPass()`) gates the firing to Full Burst windows — the velvet/modernia precedent for 'N hits during Full Burst' procs. With countScope:'gated', the counter accrues only while fbGate passes (in-FB pellet hits); partial counts carry across FB windows (no per-window reset). It fires every ~3rd pull WHILE in FB. BURST line 1 'self → Attack damage ▲10.56% + Critical Damage ▲88.17% for 10s' = burstCast → self → attackDamagePct 10.56 / 10s + critDamagePct 88.17 / 10s (self-scoped; fires on HER OWN cast, NOT fullBurstEnter — so on rotations a different B3 carries, these do NOT apply). BURST line 2 'all enemies → 1066.66% final ATK Burst Skill damage' = burstCast → enemy → flatDamage 1066.66 (single boss = the one target; burst-cast instant damage is auto-FB-exempt — the cast lands before the FB window opens; crit-on at sheet rate). NO `ignored` blocks; unmodeled arrays genuinely empty. ⚑ NEEDS-MEASUREMENT: (1) S1 fired-vs-landed pellet cadence [low]: estimate = near-equivalent at ~9/10 focus-band landing; recipe = per-shot landed-pellet count in a pum focus video (cadence stretches if landing < 10/shot). (2) S2a ≥5-pellet per-shot gate [dropped, low]: estimate = always-satisfied at single-boss landing; recipe = per-shot landed-pellet count at the recorded band (gate bites only at far band / <5 landing). (3) S2b counter is countScope:'gated' (2026-08-16 triage): the kit reads 'hitting 30 times with pellets during Full Burst', scoping the COUNTING to FB — the counter accrues only while fbGate passes (in-FB pellet hits), per blockGatesPass-at-accrual. Partial counts carry across FB windows (no per-window reset). (4) CADENCE TUPLE [mandatory, datamine-unreliable]: pullsPerSec (SG class default ~1.5) + reloadFrames 141 (datamine) + rolling-reload; recipe = rounds/min + reload gap from any pum focus video. TIER 2 (pellet-counter cadence + FB-gated counter + round-count reload + stack mechanic). rapi-red-hood.note: rapi-red-hood (Rapi: Red Hood — MG/Fire) — whole-kit model; her three skills only make sense together. Pinned line-by-line by scripts/tests/units/rapi-red-hood.test.ts (RRH1-RRH8, both formation branches). || S1 'Combat Assist' is FORMATION-BRANCHED: with NO Burst-1 ally she fills the B1 slot (burstEligibility stage 1) and grants the team burstCdr 7.48s + Attack Damage 8.02%/10s on each full burst (formation 'noB1'); WITH a B1 ally she instead self-buffs ATK 95.04%/10s (formation 'hasB1'). Both branches carry counterfactual pins. || S2: counts as elementally advantaged vs Electric (advantageVs), and carries passive Projectile Attachment Damage 150.72% + Projectile Explosion Damage 100.6%. Its rocket meter is modeled as hitCount 120 (countInFb 60, countInFbStage 3): one rocket per 120 normal attacks, halving to 60 ONLY inside the 10s window of her OWN Stage-3 cast — teammate-opened Full Bursts and her noB1 stage-1 casts run the 120 threshold. Each rocket is a PAIR: an immediate 88.11% attachment hit (flavor projectileAttachment, core TRUE — launchWeapon delivery, band-table rate) and an 88.11% storedHit explosion (flavor projectileExplosion, crit TRUE, instantInFb TRUE). MECHANIC (owner-measured red rocket meter): the meter right of the crosshair fills 0->100%; at 100% one rocket attaches. A rocket attaching DURING Full Burst explodes INSTANTLY; rockets attached OUT of burst do NOT explode until FB begins, so they ACCUMULATE and the first explosion of each FB is a BATCH of all accrued rockets, rendering as exact integer multiples of the single-body value. The meter carries across the FB boundary. || BURST: Stage 1 = self burstCdr 20s + all-ally casterAtkPct 18.01%/10s. Stage 3 = a 2808% FLIGHTED missile (delaySec 0.4 — it lands ~0.4s post-banner INSIDE her own window, so it snapshots at the full buffed state and takes FB +50% and entry auras) and CHARGE-GATED (requiresPulls 120), plus a self Projectile Attachment Damage 421.2%/10s. That 421.2% line is LIVE and formation-gated to her Stage-3 cast; it is what makes an in-window attach body land around 4.4M. || BUCKETS: Projectile Attachment/Explosion Damage compose ADDITIVELY into Damage Up (owner popup ruling; measured non-crit CORE attach 5,057,974 in her B3 window reproduces to -0.24%/+1.1% across buff states). projFactor is a flavor MARKER on the event, not a product factor. || THE EXPLOSION DOES NOT CORE (owner footage ruling, docs/probes probe u7): it is skill damage, and skill damage generally cannot core (U1 function-damage no-core default). storedHit therefore has no core field and no coreOverride — core-ineligible by storedHit default. It DOES crit (storedHit.crit), on the consistency argument that every other hit of hers crits additively at her sheet rate; the stored-hit path's crit-OFF was an artifact exemption, so removing it introduces no new mechanic and no new constant. In-FB explosion body sims 1,192,831 vs a measured 1,195,658 (-0.2%) — the explosion magnitude is confirmed correct and was never the under-modeled carrier. || DELIBERATELY COLD, DO NOT RE-FIT. Her exposed residual is a PREDICTION, not a fit. Part is generic MG-cold (board ~0.947) and part is an OBSERVED-but-unmodeled explosion CRIT magnitude question; the remaining control-comp shortfall is a count/rotation channel (sim 12 FB vs real 13), not instance magnitude — both popup classes match. Do NOT inflate atkPct or re-introduce an explosion core fraction to zero the residual. || ⚑ CARRYOVER SEMANTICS: the 2x-faster in-window meter is modeled as a THRESHOLD switch (120->60), not a +2-fill-per-hit rate. These agree in steady state but differ at the FB boundary (a meter carried in at >=60 can double-fire on entry); rocket count is conserved to O(1), only cross-boundary timing moves. A meter-carryover measurement discriminates them. || ⚑ LEDGERED, does NOT block (open-questions U15): whether the game's crit/core bracket is additive (as the sim models) or multiplicative — the x1.80 core+crit body (7,948,092) does not cleanly compose under additive constants. This applies to ALL 86 board readings, not just explosions; bounded ~0.3-0.4% of her total.

Step 3 (Red Wolf): weaponSwap 51.46%/shot, chargeMultPct 250, 10s, chargeTimeSec 0.3, plus the S2 rider atkPct 71.42 / 10s, unlimitedAmmo 10s, and the charge-damage conversion below.
RED WOLF CADENCE is decoded game data (skill 1470610 + weapon 1047002), not an estimate: rate_of_fire 200rpm = exactly 1 shot per 18 frames (0.3s) REGARDLESS of charge speed. The step-3 Charge Speed ▲100.8% makes the charge instant, so the window is fire-rate-gated, not charge-gated — that is why her CADENCE is chargeTimeSec 0.3 even though the Charge Speed ▲100.8% is also carried as a real chargeSpeedPct buff — the buff is what the excess-conversion below reads, and the swap's chargeFrames guard keeps it out of the charge-time path. ~33 shots per window; max_ammo 99 with the kit's infinite ammo, so no reload inside the window (ammo resets to max at swap expiry, which is the engine's swap behavior).
S1: 'Charge Speed ▲3.81%, stacks up to 10, 5 sec' on every normal attack = hitCount 1 chargeSpeedPct 3.81 / 5s / maxStacks 10. Its partner line — 'Convert excess over 100% Charge Speed to Charge Damage ▲240% of the excess' — is now modeled LITERALLY, as the derived-stat primitive convertExcess {from chargeSpeedPct, over 100, to chargeDamagePct, rate 240} on a passive self block (owner-directed 2026-08-11). Charge Damage is RECOMPUTED from her live Charge Speed on every read, so it ramps with her stacks instead of sitting at a baked average: 2.4 x (100.8 + 3.81 x stacks - 100) = 1.92 at zero stacks, stepping 9.144pp per stack, reaching 93.36 at ten from her own kit alone. That 93.36 is a SOLO-KIT ceiling, not a cap: the conversion reads her LIVE total Charge Speed, allies included (which is what the kit says), so on her graded PA MiKa comp alice's ▲11.67 carries her to chargeDamagePct 153.4. Her output is now team-composition-sensitive — a real consequence of modeling this faithfully, and one the flat 90 could not express. Two consequences worth knowing. (1) Red Wolf's 'Charge Speed ▲100.8% for 10 sec' is now encoded as a real chargeSpeedPct buff, where it previously existed only implicitly as the swap's chargeTimeSec 0.3 — without it the conversion has no source and reads ZERO, which is exactly what a first attempt at this measured (0.775 COLD). Her CADENCE is unchanged, but NOT via a clamp — chargeTimeSec 0.3 populates the swap's own chargeFrames, and sim.ts forces the charge-speed term to ZERO whenever swap.chargeFrames is set ('u.swap?.chargeFrames != null ? 0 : Math.min(100, …)'). That guard is what stops the 100.8 shortening her cadence; do not remove it as redundant, or her 18-frame Red Wolf gate collapses to 1 frame. (2) Outside Red Wolf her Charge Speed peaks at 38.1, far below the 100 threshold, so the conversion floors at zero there with no gating needed — the block is passive because the kit says 'continuously', and the threshold does the gating. Board 0.970 -> 1.002 (0.99 / 1.02). Pinned by scripts/tests/engine/convert-excess.test.ts (the per-stack ladder, the 93.36 cap, the zero floor, and the flat-90 counterfactual).
OUTSIDE Red Wolf she is an ordinary bolt-action SR and takes the engine's +22f bolt recovery (owner-confirmed). Her Pierce is a top-level hasPierce, so partner Pierce Damage buffs (e.g. mint's 32.72) land on her.
UNMODELED / inert: Beast Cage's DEF ▲50.68% of caster DEF (defensive, no HP pool); The Last Howl's 'Recovers 23.04% of attack damage as HP' — SELF-scoped, so it cannot reach an ally-side on-recovery consumer even if emitted, making the missing emit a consistency item and not a fit one; Step 2's taunt and Incoming healing ▲74.88% (the boss never acts, no HP pool); Step 3's 'Expand Pierce range by 100%' (no range primitive, and the boss is partless).
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured unit-level pullsPerSec, and her window is charge-time-gated anyway, so the 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her.

rouge.note:
Rouge — SR / Supporter / Electric / Burst I coin-state support (burst cd 20s). Board: 1.024 on 3 graded comps (0.96 / 1.05 / 1.07). All magnitudes are kit-literal (datamined level-10); no calibrated values. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/rouge.test.ts (17 pins), including an INERT proof that strips every Max-HP grant and moves zero damage.
HP-SCALING DETERMINATION = OFFENSIVELY INERT. Every 'Max HP ▲ X% of the skill user's Max HP' line is a casterMaxHpPct ALLY grant. Ally-granted Max HP does NOT feed a consumer's ATK-as-%-of-Max-HP conversion — that conversion counts the consumer's OWN Max HP only (MEASURED, cinderella e3 focus video; the rule is stated in docs/data/damage-calculation.md and enforced in the engine by effectiveAtk's casterIdx === self test). Rouge has no atkOfMaxHpPct line of her own, so even her self-grants feed nothing, and the engine has no HP pool — the grants move no damage. They are modeled anyway, as casterMaxHpPct effects, for kit-completeness.
OFFENSIVE — 3 load-bearing lines. (S1) burstCdr 7s to all allies every 8 Full Charges (hitCount 8; an SR lands 1 hit per charged pull). This is her biggest damage lever: it accelerates the whole team's rotation. (S2) Sword Coin Attack Damage ▲6.65% as a permanent passive on selfAndAdjacent sides:2 — 'self and 2 allies on both sides', so it is POSITIONAL and an edge-slotted rouge reaches only 3 of 5. (Burst) ATK ▲15.07% of caster ATK to all allies for 10s on her burstCast (casterAtkPct, flat-resolved).
COIN-STATE MACHINE (Sword → Shield at 30 Full Charges → Double Sword at 5 own bursts in Shield) is tracked as engine state: resource `coin` (0 = Sword, 1 = Shield, 2 = Double Sword) and resource `shieldBursts` (own bursts cast during Shield). Progression: hitCount:30 + resourceGate{coin,max:0} flips Sword → Shield and applies the Shield Coin Damage-Taken ▼15.2% line on the same fire; each burstCast under gate{coin == 1} counts a shield-era burst; gate{shieldBursts >= 5} flips Shield → Double Sword, post-increment (the maxwell precedent) so the 5th shield-era burst IS the first Double Sword cast. THE COIN STATUSES CO-EXIST — the earlier ones REMAIN when the next activates (owner ruling 2026-08-11), so `coin` is a HIGHEST-REACHED marker, not an exclusive state. The gates are therefore cumulative: the Sword rider (10.15) carries NO gate at all, because Sword Coin starts at back-row assignment and never ends, so its kit condition 'when in Sword Coin status' is unconditionally true; the Shield rider (20.1) is gate{coin >= 1}; the Double Sword rider (30.02) and the continuous Max HP ▲15.08% are gate{coin >= 2}. A Double-Sword-era burst thus carries all three riders at once, and they co-STACK rather than overwrite because the buff key is caster:slot:stat:VALUE and the three values differ. Pinned by the CO-EXISTENCE case in her spec. The Sword Coin Attack Damage ▲6.65% was already a permanent passive and is unaffected — it never switched off. The coin transitions themselves stay once-only: the Sword → Shield flip keeps gate{coin,max:0} so 30 further full charges cannot re-fire it. Same-frame BLOCK ORDER is load-bearing here and nothing lints it: the shieldBursts increment must stay listed before the coin flip that reads it.
SHIELD COIN DAMAGE-TAKEN ▼15.2% IS INERT, and not only because it is defensive. It is encoded on an ALLY target, but damageTakenPct is a boss-side StatKey — the engine sums it from the enemy buff list only, so an ally-targeted one is applied and never read. Correct outcome, off-contract encoding: it reads as a live buff to anyone scanning this file. validate-overrides warns on the mismatch since 2026-08-10 (BOSS_ONLY_BUFF_STATS in src/skills/validate-structural.ts): the warning is expected — keep the line, never "fix" the target or the sign.
⚑ FLAGS (UNMEASURED). (2) SHIELD-COIN BURST RIDER HEAL ASYMMETRY [coin-state-gated + measurement-gated, tier 2] — four of the five Max-HP lines say 'without restoring HP'; the Shield-Coin burst rider (Max HP ▲20.1%) ALONE omits that clause, so read literally it RESTORES HP and would emit a recovery event arming on-recovery consumers (crown's 'when recovery takes effect' team ATK buff). The coin gate is expressible now, but the heal itself is NOT modeled pending footage; the marginal impact is small, since crown's recovery consumer is typically already saturated by her own heals. Recipe: focus video with a recovery consumer — does rouge's burst proc crown's recovery buff once Shield Coin is up? (3) BACK-ROW CONDITION on S2 has no engine primitive and is modeled as an unconditional passive; rouge is an SR and is always back row, so the assumption holds at scope lock. Documented, not encoded.
RAMP: she carries no stack-ramp line — the coin tiers are discrete resource states, not a ramp, so there is no bake-at-cap approximation here to correct.

Affects self. Muscle Up: Max HP ▲ 3.04%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 2 sec.' → TWO single-effect chargeCounter count:1 blocks on self: buff {stat:targetMaxHpPct, value:3.04, maxStacks:5, durationSec:2} + resource {name:muscleUp, delta:1}. A multi-effect chargeCounter CYCLES its effects one-per-charge instead of applying both (power precedent 2026-08-03), so the buff and the pool increment are separate blocks. Every rumani pull IS a full charge (RL charge 60f, no dump mode — same precedent as power's per-charge stack buff), so the per-full-charge cadence equals her shot cadence. targetMaxHpPct on self resolves to a flat maxHpFlat of 3.04% of her OWN static Max HP per stack; the grant is DAMAGE-INERT (rumani has no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer and v1 models no damage-taken) but OBSERVABLE — the spec pins the 1-per-pull cadence, the 1→5 stack ramp, the 2s window, and the SAWTOOTH: her 129f (2.15s) reload gap EXCEEDS the 2s expiry, so stacks provably lapse to 1 after every reload (110 applies / 22 fresh ramps over 180s). (2) S2 Muscle Time '■ Activates when hitting a target's Parts for 5 time(s). Affects all allies. Damage to Parts ▲ 10.05% for 5 sec.' → hitCount count:5, target allies, buff {stat:partsDamagePct, value:10.05, durationSec:5}. ⚑ the sim has no parts axis, so the counter counts EVERY hit as a parts hit and partsDamagePct is inert vs the partless scope-lock boss (helm-H4 precedent) — inert either way, never fudged. (3) Burst Almighty Muscle, three burstCast blocks: (a) self {stat:targetMaxHpPct, value:15.13, durationSec:10} — DAMAGE-INERT (same reasoning as L1; pinned by cast cadence + self scope + the exact 15.13/3.04 flat-value ratio to the L1 grant, both scaling off her own static Max HP); (b) all allies {stat:normalAttackPct, value:10.05, durationSec:10} — LOAD-BEARING: normalAttackPct scales the normal-attack multiplier (sim.ts normalScale) of every holder's normal-category hits; it must NOT be the attackDamagePct Damage-Up bucket (that would dilute AND lift skill/burst damage) — the spec pins the bucket split directly; (c) self {stat:damageTakenPct, value:-20.06, durationSec:10} gated by resourceGate {name:muscleUp, min:5}. || THE MAX-STACKS GATE (L6): the kit's 'Activates when Muscle Up is at max stacks' is a STACK GATE the engine has no buff-stack gate primitive for; the override mirrors the stack count into the muscleUp resource pool (0→5, +1 per full charge, clamped) and reads it via resourceGate — the exact power precedent (2026-08-03). ⚑ EXPIRY DIVERGENCE: the pool never lapses, but the real stacks drop 2 sec after the last full charge; rumani's reload gap (~2.15s + charge) EXCEEDS the 2s expiry (unlike power, whose 3s expiry beat her reload gap by 8 frames), so the pool can OVERSTATE stacks just after a reload boundary — the gate may read open where the real kit reads closed. estimate: zero DAMAGE divergence either way (v1 consumes no self damageTakenPct, and the buff itself is a defensive observable only); worst case is one extra gated buffApply per post-reload cast. recipe: a focused rumani recording across a >2s fire pause — read the Muscle Up icon expiry vs whether the next burst grants the damage-taken shield. tier: low (defensive-only consequence). ⚑ CHANNEL: damageTakenPct here is SELF-held and NEGATIVE (a reduction); the engine's live damageTakenPct channel is the boss-debuff read (positive = boss takes more), so this grant is consumed by NOTHING in v1 — pinned self-held (targetIdx never null) to rule out the catastrophic boss-debuff flip. || TIER 2 (all-ally scoped burst buff with duration; burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter identity load-bearing — pinned in a B1-contention arm vs liter; stack gate via resource pool). rupee.note: Rupee (slug rupee) — AR / Attacker / Iron / Burst II (cd 20s), Tetra; ammo 60, reloadFrames 81, normalMult 13.65, rate_of_fire 720 (12 rounds/s nominal), hitsPerShot 1, critRate 15 / critDamage 150. FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-08-04 (no prior override / kit-status row; simSupported was false). EXACT SLUG: `rupee` — the base AR/Iron unit, NOT `rupee-winter-shopper` (AR/Electric B1 Defender, aka rws — an entirely different kit). A travel-rewards-themed Iron attacker: her OWN damage is her AR spray + a modest burst nuke; her team value is (a) a periodic crit-rate feed to Iron Code allies (S1) and (b) an all-ally ATK window on her burst that unlocks ONLY once her self Mileage stack is maxed. || FULL-KIT AUDIT (every line accounted for): S1 'Prize' — 'Activates after landing 100 normal attack(s). Affects all Iron Code allies.' (L1) 'Critical Rate ▲ 2.24% for 10 sec' = IMPLEMENTED hitCount:100 → alliesOfElement Iron → critRatePct 2.24 / durationSec 10. UNSCOPED critRatePct per the helm rule: the text says plain 'Critical Rate ▲' with NO 'of normal attacks' clause, so it lifts every crit-eligible hit of the Iron allies (normals AND skill/burst instances) — NOT critRateNormalPct. 'Affects all Iron Code allies' = TargetDef alliesOfElement 'Iron' (INCLUDES self — she is Iron, no except-self clause; the mica-snow-buddy all-allies self-inclusion convention). 'landing' == firing: v1 has no miss model (clay precedent). (L2) 'Increases stack count of buffs by 1.' = SPLIT — the roster-wide buff-stack-amplifier line (word_group 10001; the same sentence carried by soda/mica-snow-buddy/diesel/alice-wonderland-bunny). SELF slice: the only stackable buff rupee herself holds is Mileage (her S2), so the self-directed portion is MODELED as +1 to the `mileage` resource pool on the same hitCount:100 trigger — the mica-snow-buddy/pepper construction for exactly this line (self stackable resource folded, acceleration of the max-stacks gate included: pool reaches 5 at shot 120 instead of shot 150). TWO documented divergences from the full in-game mechanic, both ⚑ (caveats 2/3): the CROSS-ALLY slice (+1 stack to teammates' own stackable buffs) has no engine primitive (out-of-domain), and the mileage ATK-buff COMPONENT of the self stack is NOT granted — buff instances key on caster+slot+stat+value (sim.ts KR stacking rule), so a skill1-slot mileage buff would co-exist as a SECOND instance (up to 2×5 stacks = double-counted ATK), not merge into S2's Mileage; the pool-only encoding keeps the gate timing right and under-credits her own ATK by ≤1 stack (13.8%) during the opening ramp. The line stays verbatim in unmodeled.skill1 (partial-modeling audit trail). S2 'Mileage' — 'Activates after 30 attacks. Affects self. Mileage: ATK ▲ 13.8%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.' = IMPLEMENTED as TWO blocks on hitCount:30 → self: (a) the real buff atkPct 13.8 / maxStacks 5 / durationSec 15, and (b) +1 to the `mileage` resource pool — the power (Blood Fiend) stack-gate mirror: the engine has no buff-stack gate primitive, so the burst's 'Mileage at max stacks' condition reads the pool via resourceGate {min:5}. Stack semantics = the engine's refresh-on-reapply (each proc +1 stack, shared instance, expiry refreshed): at her sustained AR cadence (a proc every 30 shots ≈ 3.2s including the 81f reload) applications beat the 15s expiry by ~5×, so stacks climb monotonically to 5 and never lapse while she keeps firing — the pool and the buff never disagree inside a sim fight (⚑4 no-lapse, power/pepper precedent). BURST 'Single Payment' (InstantArea, Iron code, prefer HighAttack) — (B1) 'Affects enemies within range. Deals 274.28% of final ATK as damage.' = IMPLEMENTED burstCast → enemy → flatDamage 274.28: '% of final ATK' is exactly flatDamage's caster-final-ATK scaling; the single partless v1 boss is the only enemy, so the AoE 'enemies within range' collapses to the boss taking the full value (diesel/pepper multi-target-burst convention); burst CAST lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens, so it never takes the +50% FB major (verified fact 2026-07-13) and snapshots pre-FB; crit-eligible at her sheet rate (flatDamage default, U1); Iron-flavored via her element (neutral on the Fire scope-lock boss). (B2) 'Activates when Mileage is at max stacks. Affects all allies. ATK ▲ 19.8% for 5 sec.' = IMPLEMENTED burstCast + resourceGate {mileage ≥ 5} → allies → atkPct 19.8 / durationSec 5. atkPct = % of each holder's OWN ATK (the text says plain 'ATK ▲', no 'of the skill user's ATK' — not casterAtkPct). 'Activates when...' is a TRIGGER CONDITION on the whole ■ bullet, so the gate keys on burstCast (her own casts only — she is the sole caster of her burst), NOT fullBurstEnter (which would over-fire on rotations completed by a competing B2 — the clay own-cast convention; in the fixture she is the only B2 regardless). Gate is LOAD-BEARING: an ungated model over-fires the team ATK window on every early cast before Mileage completes. || EVIDENCE TIER: all live values are kit-text-literal (2.24/10s, 13.8/5/15s, 274.28, 19.8/5s); the estimated quantities are the cadence tuple and the ⚑ cluster below. TIER 2 (status-gate via resource mirror + element-scoped buff + stack mechanics). Faithful>fit; measured>fudge. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-04.
