Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-25 (cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5; S5/S6/S7 claude-opus-5; GO faithfulness — see manual-review). MODEL: S1 'after 10 normal attacks' = hitCount:10 → self ATK ▲23.15% / maxStacks 5 / 5s (engine derives the stack level from cadence; at the datamined cadence it reaches 5/5 and holds — the 5s window bridges the 159f reload). S2 'HP<60% → Crit Dmg ▲6.61% continuously' = passive self critDamagePct 6.61 (permanent) with rampSec:56 — the equal-integral proxy for the HP<60% step-on at ~28s (a linear 0→full ramp over 2T has the same time-integral as a step at T; T≈28s from the compounding self-drain below). BURST: 'HP<50% → Crit Rate ▲19.57%/10s' = burstCast self critRatePct 19.57/10s, modeled UNGATED (rampSec is unusable on a per-cast 10s window — its clock would ramp INSIDE the window — so the buff is full-value on every cast and the pre-~37s casts are an over-credit ⚑). burstCast (her OWN cast), NOT fullBurstEnter — controlComp carries helm as co-B3, so team FBs (11) ≠ her casts (6) and fullBurstEnter would over-fire. '849.15% Burst Skill damage' = burstCast flatDamage vs enemy ('all enemies' = the single boss); a burst CAST lands BEFORE the Full Burst window, so it is FB-exempt by timing (no +50% major; verified fact 2026-07-13) and crit-eligible. S2 '30% chance when attacked → 138.24% additional damage' is UNMODELED (sanctioned skip): 'when this unit is hit' never fires in-sim — the v1 boss has no modeled attack cadence. No weapon swap, no charge, no DoT, hitsPerShot 1, element = clean ×1.10 default. HP-THRESHOLD GATES (the kit's design center): S1's 'Current HP ▼4.01%' is a self HP COST — the engine has no HP pool, so it is unmodeled as HP, but it is LOAD-BEARING as the mechanism that opens the two gates: current-HP decay is multiplicative (×0.9599/proc), so HP<60% at 13 procs (130 rounds, ~28s) and HP<50% at 17 procs (170 rounds, ~37s) from self-drain alone; boss damage only makes these EARLIER. These derived crossing times feed the rampSec:56 proxy and the burst over-credit ⚑. ENCODING-CHOICE NOTE (cross-family): the fable S2b reviewer recommended modeling the gates literally via a bloodProc proc-count resource pool + resourceGate (step-on at proc 13/17); the opus S5/S6 reviewers converged on the rampSec/ungated ⚑ proxy here, reasoning that the proc-count threshold is itself cadence-derived and ignores boss damage, so encoding a precise gate would be false precision — the driver adopted the opus-convergent proxy. The resource-pool gate is a legitimate future improvement if an HP pool primitive or a measured fight lands. ⚑1 CADENCE TUPLE (datamine-unreliable): 20-ammo AR with normalMult 27.08 (~3× the usual AR per-shot) + melee-slash flavor = non-class fire-mode tell; datamined pullsPerSec + reloadFrames 159 unverified. The hitCount:10 frequency, the 5-stack steady state, the rampSec:56, and the burst over-credit all scale with true rounds/sec. Recipe: rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video. ⚑2 HP-GATE TIMING: rampSec:56 (S2) and the ungated-burst over-credit are DERIVED from the compounding self-drain reading, not measured; real fights cross earlier (boss damage). Recipe: HP bar + first crit-popup timing from a focus video. ⚑3 S2a ATTACKED-PROC (unmodeled): est 0 in-sim / ~0-3% of real solo total (a handful of boss hits × 30% × 138.24%). Recipe: focus video — count her additional-damage popups coinciding with boss attacks on her; if material, model as a dot at the measured proc cadence.

snow-white-innocent-days.note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-03 (FROM-SCRATCH unit — no shipped override existed before this run; simSupported was false; authored test-first, pinned by scripts/tests/units/snow-white-innocent-days.test.ts). snow-white-innocent-days — Snow White: Innocent Days, AR/Iron/Attacker/Burst III (40s CD), variant of base snow-white (slug snow-white — the AR/Iron cannon-swap unit; NOT this unit) and of snow-white-heavy-arms (SR/Water). Her kit is a hit-counter kit: every 30 normal-attack hits her S1 fires (ammo-capacity stack + damage rider), every 50 hits her S2 fires an AoE rider — and her burst drops that S2 requirement by 20 (50 → 30) for 10s while granting ATK + unlimited ammo. LINE-BY-LINE: S1-L1 'Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 25.66%, stacks up to 5 time(s), lasts 5 sec' (self, every 30 hits) → buff maxAmmoPct 25.66 / durationSec 5 / maxStacks 5 (engine stacks add value×stacks into maxAmmo(); re-apply refreshes duration and adds a stack up to the cap). STACK DYNAMICS (measured in the control fixture): 67 applies over 180s (= floor(2028 shots/30)) and the cap IS reached — stacks climb to 5, driven by her unlimited-ammo burst windows (no reload downtime → 2.5s per 30-hit proc < the 5s duration); out-of-window cadence with reloads is ~3.2s/proc. S1-L2 'enemies within attack range: 188.68% of final ATK' (every 30 hits) → flatDamage 188.68, target enemy (single partless boss at scope), same hitCount-30 trigger as L1 (two blocks, same cadence — the kit fires both lines off the same 30-hit activation). S2-L3 '50 normal attacks → all enemies: 61.69% of final ATK' → flatDamage 61.69 on hitCount 50 with countInFb 30 (see L5). S2-L4 'using Burst Skill → self: Attack Damage ▲ 21.12% for 10 sec' → buff attackDamagePct 21.12 (Damage-Up bucket — 'Attack Damage' per StatKey SSOT) on burstCast — NOT fullBurstEnter: the kit says 'when using Burst Skill', and a fullBurstEnter encoding would re-fire her on every FB window including another B3's (2× uptime in a two-B3 comp). BURST-L5 'Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼ 20 time(s) for 10 sec' → enacted as countInFb 30 on the S2 hitCount trigger (rapi-red-hood precedent: own-burst threshold switch modeled as the FB-window threshold; her B3 cast opens the FB window, and the ~10s FB window ≈ the kit's 10s duration). ⚑⚑ KNOWN SCOPE DIVERGENCE (S2b claude-fable-5 flagged; driver reconciled, kept): countInFb reads the GLOBAL FB window, not her cast — in a multi-B3 comp (the control fixture has helm alternating) the lowered threshold also applies during FB windows ANOTHER B3 opened (~+1-2 extra 61.69% procs per foreign window; ~0.5-1% of her total), and her window is FB-anchored, not cast-anchored (cast lands ~0.3s before FB opens). The owner-anchored primitive exists ONLY for chargeCounter (sim.ts inBurst = lastBurstCastFrame + 10s), NOT for hitCount — an exact encoding would need an engine change, and S4 freezes src/engine/**. Two-block ownBurstGate/fbGate compositions were analyzed and rejected (parallel counters drift phase from the true carry-over switch, and no gate expresses 'outside the owner's 10s window' — they under-credit foreign windows worse than countInFb over-credits them). So: countInFb + this ⚑, exact at single-B3 scope, bounded over-credit in multi-B3. The counter CARRIES OVER the window boundary (no reset — RRH semantics). Owner recipe to falsify: count 61.69% popups in a recording during a foreign-B3 FB window (should be 50-hit spacing, not 30). BURST-L6 'ATK ▲ 97.2% for 10 sec' → buff atkPct 97.2 on burstCast (self). BURST-L7 'Unlimited ammunition for 10 sec' → unlimitedAmmo effect, durationSec 10 (engine buff stat 'unlimitedAmmo'; shots in-window neither consume ammo nor advance the magazine ordinal; a reload already in flight at cast still completes mid-window — observed 3× in the fixture). CADENCE TUPLE ⚑ (datamine, unmeasured): rate_of_fire 720 → 12 pulls/s = engine AR class default (no charFixes needed); reloadFrames 81 (datamine); ammo 60; burstGaugePerShot 0.05 (datamine burst_energy_pershot 500); hitsPerShot 1. Burst gauge: no gauge-per-shot.json row (engine falls back to characters.json). Element: Iron vs the Fire-boss fixture is NEUTRAL (Iron beats Water), no elemental major at scope.
